2.name: Sharptalon's Claw
desc: Bring Sharptalon's Claw to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.
objectives: Bring Sharptalon's Claw to Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.
details: The mighty hippogryph Sharptalon has been slain, with the claw of the felled beast serving as a testament to your victory. Senani Thunderheart at the Splintertree Post will no doubt be interested in seeing this trophy as proof of your deeds.
completion: Most impressive, $N... the claw of Sharptalon could not have been easy to get! The Ashenvale Hunt goes well for you!

BSharptalon had long terrorized the peons from the lumber camps near its path as they tried to travel here to Splintertree Post. No doubt once the word gets out that it was you who put down the beast, many rousing songs of your bravery will be heard at campfires and lumber mills across Ashenvale!

26.name: A Lesson to Learn
desc: Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
objectives: Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
details: $N, I have been following your progress with much delight. You are most assuredly developing yourself into a valued protector of nature.

BThe time has come for you to learn more about one of the various animal aspects that Cenarius has blessed us with the ability to change into - one that affords you command and mastery of the water. For this, you must travel to the village of Nighthaven in Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze of the Cenarion Circle there. He will guide you further.
completion: Salutations, young $C; the time has come for you to know our aquatic form. It is one that lets you move freely and indefinitely through water. You will find this aspect a useful tool and a blessing... but it is one that must be earned before it is mastered.
BYou will face two trials to overcome. The first will test your ability to work in water under pressure. The second will test your resolve to understand the aspects of the form itself.
BStand ready, as the time of testing is now upon us.

50.name: Sweet Amber
desc: Grimbooze Thunderbrew wants Truesilver.
objectives: Grimbooze Thunderbrew wants Truesilver.
details: I'll mix and mix till we have a mash$BFor this will be our own private stash$BA still must be fashioned of metal strong$BBring me some Truesilver so I can finish this song.
completion: Hiccup! Ho ho!

74.name: The Legend of Stalvan
desc: The Torn Journal page you discovered provides your next clue.
objectives: The Torn Journal page you discovered provides your next clue.
details: Inside the crate you find various objects: musty heirlooms, a family portrait, a few hunting trophies and some old books. Near the bottom, underneath a ceramic vase, you uncover A Torn Journal Page.
completion: I can barely make out those letters. But that writing style reminds me of something I once saw before my vision became so poor.

98.name: The Legend of Stalvan
desc: Kill Stalvan Mistmantle and show Madame Eva his family ring.
objectives: Kill Stalvan Mistmantle and show Madame Eva his family ring.
details: Stalvan Mistmantle led a life of depravity. Innocent victims died by his hand. Undoubtedly he is guilty of countless crimes. Now the lunatic threatens Darkshire. The Light only knows what sordid acts he is plotting. Travel to his cottage just north of town, $C, and execute Stalvan, once and for all.
BWhen the deed is done, travel to Madame Eva's and show her his family ring. After all, it was her premonition that led to this gruesome discovery. But Darkshire is safer because of her.
completion: I know, $N: Stalvan is dead. I sensed a wave of hope ripple through the tainted forest. Once and for all, Duskwood is free from his blood thirst. My joy is hampered by thoughts of those who fell prey to the horrible beast. Nonetheless, you are a brave and cunning $c.

122.name: Underbelly Scales
desc: Gather 6 Underbelly Whelp Scales from Black Dragon Whelps, and bring them to Verner Osgood in Redridge.
objectives: Gather 6 Underbelly Whelp Scales from Black Dragon Whelps, and bring them to Verner Osgood in Redridge.
details: I need some underbelly scales from black dragon whelps to pay for the shoes Argus sent me from Goldshire. If you can get 6 of them for me, then I can pay Argus with some... and have enough left to fashion something for you.
BBlack dragon whelps are often flying around south of Lakeshire, but they like to wander. You might have to just keep an eye out and hunt them when you see them.
completion: Thanks! These will get me out of debt to Argus...

146.name: Messenger to Darkshire
desc: Return to Magistrate Solomon with Lord Ebonlocke's letter of response.
objectives: Return to Magistrate Solomon with Lord Ebonlocke's letter of response.
details: If I did not know Magistrate Solomon personally, I would say the man has gone mad. Send the Night Watch to Lakeshire because Stormwind refuses aid? The Night Watch was formed because Stormwind left us when this foul magic seeped into the land. If I sent my Night Watch, this town would be overrun by evil before the guards even reached the forest's edge.
BTake this letter of response to your Master in Lakeshire.
completion: By the Light! The Stormwind Army retreated from Westfall. And the Guard no longer protects Darkshire? There is some treachery abound. How could this be so?
BOh I forgot to reward your service, $C. Here are some coins. Now excuse me. Something is amiss in Stormwind and I must get to the bottom of it.

170.name: A New Threat
desc: Balir Frosthammer wants you to kill 6 Rockjaw Troggs and 6 Burly Rockjaw Troggs.
objectives: Balir Frosthammer wants you to kill 6 Rockjaw Troggs and 6 Burly Rockjaw Troggs.
details: I hope you're here to lend us a hand, $c. After the last trogg attack, we could use all the help we can get.
BI hear the buggers have been popping up all across the lands, and it seems Coldridge Valley is no exception. They've been spotted all over the hills to the southeast and near the frozen lake.
BAnd that's not all, just a few nights ago, they attacked and overran our camp to the west!
BWe're a bit shorthanded here, $g lad : lass;, and we need strong arms to help drive the troggs back.
completion: If the problems we've had here are indicative of what is happening elsewhere in our lands, by Magni's beard, we have some troubles ahead of us! I can only hope that the king and Senate are taking steps to deal with the threat the troggs pose.

194.name: Raptor Mastery
desc: Hemet Nesingwary wants you to kill 10 Stranglethorn Raptors.
objectives: Hemet Nesingwary wants you to kill 10 Stranglethorn Raptors.
details: So you think your hunting skills are in tip-top shape? I can put them to the test in a jiffy. Head out into that jungle and kill 10 Stranglethorn Raptors. We'll see just how much of a big game hunter you are.
BAnd no, I won't tell you where you can find them! Locating the beasts is half the challenge.
completion: Nicely done, old chap!

218.name: The Stolen Journal
desc: Grelin Whitebeard wants you to kill Grik'nir the Cold, and retrieve his journal.
objectives: Grelin Whitebeard wants you to kill Grik'nir the Cold, and retrieve his journal.
details: My journal! They took it away to the cave. The one that had it... It was a big brute with some odd markings on his skin and face. I didn't get a much better look than that.
BYou've had some luck with the trolls, maybe you could go get it back for me?
completion: Wonderful, $N! Many thanks for retrieving my notebook. Well, it would seem that the troll situation here in Coldridge Valley is under control and not much cause for worry.
BAfter I put the finishing touches on my report, I'll need someone to courier it to my brother Senir.

266.name: Inquire at the Inn
desc: Search the inn for clues about the shadowy figure.
objectives: Search the inn for clues about the shadowy figure.
details: Here is your book, and good luck with your inquiries.
BYou might want to expand your search to the inn. If the person whom you seek spent time in town, then chances are someone saw him there.
completion: Oh yeah, I remember this book. Its owner rented a room for a few days, and spent his nights at the bar, writing.
BHe left town in a hurry, muttering about being hunted by...something. Last I saw him he was heading west out of town, looking for a new spot to hide.
BThe first place he'd find to the west is Raven Hill...

290.name: Lifting the Curse
desc: Get the Intrepid Strongbox Key from Captain Halyndor.
Use the key to open the Intrepid's Locked Strongbox.
objectives: Get the Intrepid Strongbox Key from Captain Halyndor.
BUse the key to open the Intrepid's Locked Strongbox.
details: To break the curse and free all of my brethren, the...thing...stowed on my ship must be retrieved and cleansed! I don't know what it was, but I do know that it was stored securely in the ship's strongbox, which Captain Halyndor lorded over.
BMy old captain is still in my dreams. I know he walks my doomed ship, the Intrepid. Get the key from him, and use it to open the Intrepid's strongbox.
BThen, after you have the cursed thing, bring it to the priest Glorin Steelbrow in town.
completion: The key is rusted but it fits the lock neatly.

314.name: Protecting the Herd
desc: Rudra Amberstill wants you to slay Vagash and bring his fang to her at the Ram ranch.
objectives: Rudra Amberstill wants you to slay Vagash and bring his fang to her at the Ram ranch.
details: We heard the cries in the middle of the night. Then this morning, sure enough, the herd was missing two rams. That dastardly beast known as Vagash has been preying on our livelihood. With most of King Magni's army off in distant lands fighting with the Alliance, there is no one to keep Vagash at bay.
BPerhaps you are brave enough to seek out the beast and slay him. Bring me one of his fangs and I will reward you. Vagash lurks just above the ranch here, but be warned, he is deadly.
completion: Very well done! Veron will be so happy when he hears the good news. To kill Vagash is no easy task. I imagine one day you'll be fighting alongside King Magni's men on the Alliance Front.

338.name: The Green Hills of Stranglethorn
desc: Collect the missing pages from The Green Hills of Stranglethorn manuscript. Once all four chapters are complete, return them to Barnil.
objectives: Collect the missing pages from The Green Hills of Stranglethorn manuscript. Once all four chapters are complete, return them to Barnil.
details: Master Nesingwary will be so upset if he finds out!

BHe trusted me to proofread the manuscript of his novel, The Green Hills of Stranglethorn. Everything was going well, but a large gust of wind blew through the camp and scattered the pages everywhere!
BI was able to gather most of the pages but many are still strewn about the jungle. Collect the pages to complete each of the four chapters.
BI will help you organize them. Return the chapters to me once you have all four.
completion: You've certainly saved me a heap of trouble, $N! I can't thank you enough. It shouldn't be long now until we see Master Nesingwary's book in libraries throughout the world!

362.name: The Haunted Mills
desc: Slay Devlin Agamand, and bring Devlin's Remains to Coleman Farthing in Brill.
objectives: Slay Devlin Agamand, and bring Devlin's Remains to Coleman Farthing in Brill.
details: Devlin Agamand was the younger of two sons in the Agamand family, and in life the two could not be more different. Thurman was tall and gentle while his younger brother was weak and sharp tongued.
BWhen Agamand Mills fell to the Plague, I was not surprised to hear that Devlin was quick to succumb. His mad chattering can still be heard near the road leading to the Agamand Mills.
BI'm collecting the remains of the Agamands, and I want poor Devlin. Find him, destroy him, and bring me his bones.
completion: Thank you. Devlin's bones will rest nicely on my mantle.
BIf my cold heart can find warmth, it is in knowing that the Agamands are destroyed. They failed me and my family when the Plague came - now I swear I will smash their remains under my heel!

386.name: What Comes Around...
desc: Bring the head of Targorr the Dread to Guard Berton in Lakeshire.
objectives: Bring the head of Targorr the Dread to Guard Berton in Lakeshire.
details: Targorr the Dread served under Gath'Ilzogg as supreme Executioner. His methods were ruthless, even by filthy orc standards. Men who fought bravely to defend the Kingdom were tortured on his whim. Now he is being held in the Stormwind Stockade, sentenced to die. Yet something is amiss. One of the bureaucratic nobles put a hold on his execution. I am sure foul play is in the works.
BPut an end to Targorr the Dread, $N. Travel to The Stockade and behead him before trickery is upon us.
completion: Targorr the Dread has finally met his fate. I for one am glad to hear the beast now knows what it is like to be on the receiving end of Death's ruthless grip. You have done well, $N. Sometimes the truest justice can only be found outside the courtroom and beyond the clouded vision of politics.

434.name: The Attack!
desc: Remain in the garden until Lord Gregor Lescovar and Marzon the Silent Blade have had their conversation. Afterwards, kill them both before returning to Elling Trias in Stormwind.
objectives: Remain in the garden until Lord Gregor Lescovar and Marzon the Silent Blade have had their conversation. Afterwards, kill them both before returning to Elling Trias in Stormwind.
details: After I put on Spybot's disguise, he'll head in to talk to Lescovar. The guards should let him pass no problem.
BWhile you were getting materials for me, I took care of informing Marzon that it was time for him and Lescovar to meet again. I even dropped some false information.

BLescovar will dismiss his guards and wait for Marzon out here in the garden. After you catch wind of talk about the Defias, make your move. You need to kill them both before the guards return! When you're done, speak to Trias.
completion: So it is done? Good. Thank you greatly for your discretion, $N. You've proven worthy on more than one count. I'll be sure to keep my eyes on you and your progress within the Alliance.
BBe sure to keep your nose clean.

458.name: The Woodland Protector
desc: Seek out the dryad known as Tarindrella.
objectives: Seek out the dryad known as Tarindrella.
details: Thank goodness you are here, $c. Strange news has traveled to me through the whisperings of the forest spirits.

BThe mysterious woodland protector, Tarindrella, has returned to Shadowglen. The dryad's presence has not been felt in the forests of Kalimdor in years. Something is surely amiss if she has journeyed back to this land.
BSeek out Tarindrella and see what business she tends to in our grove. One of the Sentinels reported seeing her to the southwest of Aldrassil.
completion: I see you found me, young $R. Melithar is a wise druid to have sent you.

482.name: Dalaran's Intentions
desc: Speak with Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.
objectives: Speak with Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.
details: Of course! How could I have forgotten?

BAmbermill was one of the sites earmarked by the Kirin Tor, noted because it houses a dormant ley energy node. The wizards must be planning to reactivate the node and use its energies for some greater purpose.
BWe cannot allow this to happen...
BIt will take a great amount of power to activate the area's ley energies, we can stall them by taking the pendants away from the wizards.
BRelay this information to Allister, he will decide a course of action.
completion: Ill news you bring, $N. If Dalar is correct--and I've no reason to believe he isn't--we must move quickly.
BI must confer with him on our plan of attack. But in the meanwhile we will have to delay their progress.

506.name: Blackmoore's Legacy
desc: Return the information gathered by Gol'dir to Krusk in Tarren Mill.
objectives: Return the information gathered by Gol'dir to Krusk in Tarren Mill.
details: A day or two ago, I was visited by the leader of this Syndicate. His name was Aliden Perenolde, and styled himself lord of this land. He confided in me his plans to take the orcs that stood against him as slaves, just as his father and his mentor, the despised Blackmoore, had planned.
BMore important was that he brought his mistress, a wisp of a girl named Elysa. Around her neck was the pendant the Warchief desires.
BNow go, I will make my own way, after I have settled my business here.
completion: The nerve of those overbearing humans! We'll show them that the orcs shall never submit to their will!
BThis will now be our mission, in addition to recovering the trinket the Warchief desires. It would seem that by accomplishing one, we will also accomplish the other.

530.name: A Husband's Revenge
desc: Kill Valdred Moray.
Bring his hands to Raleigh Andrean in the Undercity.
objectives: Kill Valdred Moray.
BBring his hands to Raleigh Andrean in the Undercity.
details: Valdred, once my good friend, was my wife's murderer. Although I am incapable of grieving, I do yearn for revenge. If you kill Valdred and bring me his cursed hands, then I will reward you.
BI last heard he was at the Greymane Wall in southern Silverpine, trying to flee into the kingdom of Gilneas.
completion: Ah, good. These hands killed my wife, Deliah. Revenge for her murder was my only care, and you were the instrument of that revenge.

BHere, take the ring you returned earlier. Deliah has been dead to me for so long, her ring is a bauble I no longer care to keep. Instead, I will keep these hands as a remembrance of my friend's betrayal.

554.name: Stormpike's Deciphering
desc: Take the Ensorcelled Parchment to Prospector Stormpike in Ironforge.
objectives: Take the Ensorcelled Parchment to Prospector Stormpike in Ironforge.
details: Prospector Stormpike is a master of decryption and deciphering. If you take the parchment you found to him, then with luck he can make sense of it. Stormpike is currently studying in the Prospector headquarters in Ironforge.
BAnd when you see him tell him you spoke with me - I've been sending him quite a lot of business lately.
completion: A wise decision. I don't believe there is a scholar other than myself with the skills to translate this scroll. And if its contents prove interesting, fear not. I will send for you.

578.name: The Stone of the Tides
desc: Find the haunted island for Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay.
objectives: Find the haunted island for Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay.
details: If there is indeed a goblin mage and water elementals haunting the island, it could mean the Stone of the Tides can be mine!

BI want you to locate this haunted island... find out what's going on. Oh, and if you perhaps want to find out more about the Stone of the Tides, take this scrip to the Stormwind Library, they should be able to find you a copy of the book I first came across the legend in.
BCould it be that Gazban actually discovered the Stone...?
completion: So the stories were true! Incredible!
BHowever, we will need to figure out a way to defeat the curse of the Stone of the Tides, if we are to retrieve it. The curse is magical business, we'll need one of those wizards to help us out.

602.name: Magical Analysis
desc: Bring the water elemental bracers to Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver in Dalaran.
objectives: Bring the water elemental bracers to Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver in Dalaran.
details: From what I've heard, the mages of Dalaran are busy with the reconstruction of their destroyed city, I'm sure you can find one of them who will spare some time to look at the bracers. If there's anything I know about mages, they can't resist a magical puzzle.

BTake the bag of water elemental bracers and see if they can shed any light on the Stone's curse. Look for the Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver in particular. I've dealt with him before, and his knowledge is vast.
completion: The Stone of the Tides? Most interesting. It might surprise you to know that I wrote a tome - several years ago - pertaining to the legends of the Gurubashi Empire. I do know quite a bit about the Stone.
BAt least one of these bracers appears to have some magical residue I can analyze.
BLet's see what I can see...

626.name: Cortello's Riddle
desc: Solve the riddle!
objectives: Solve the riddle!
details: To Lordaeron! The great land of turmoil$BWhere brave soldiers with death do toil$BFind your way through the great unrest$BThere you will find the end to this quest$BAlong the coast of the Hinterlands, at the base of the great falls$BUnderneath the water there does your treasure call!
completion: You open the chest to discover....

650.name: Ripple Recovery
desc: Talk to Gilveradin Sunchaser; his camp is located in the Hinterlands.
objectives: Talk to Gilveradin Sunchaser; his camp is located in the Hinterlands.
details: The elf you will need to talk to is Gilveradin Sunchaser. He can name any wine, vintage and all, just by smell alone! He can package up the ripple we need, so you'll need to talk with him. We need six bottles for packaging, two for dad, and how ever many he'll want... and believe me, he'll want some. When you've packaged the ripple and got dad's two bottles, come back here!
BGilveradin's camp is near some high elf lodge in the Hinterlands, and those high elves are not good. Trust me.
completion: Ah, so you know Malton? He is an old drinking companion of mine. You see, I have found something that transcends the boundaries of artificial treaties and alliances - alcohol. Were we all to slake our thirsts on its blissful qualities, we all would be in a much better place spiritually.
BAlas, something tells me that your visit here is not to learn of alcohol's redeeming values, now is it.

674.name: Raising Spirits
desc: Give the Raptor Talon Amulet to Gor'mul.
objectives: Give the Raptor Talon Amulet to Gor'mul.
details: Here, take this amulet to Gor'mul, and see if the raptors' strength can awaken the flame of the warrior that once burned through his veins.
completion: What is this? Polished bone. What use have I for polished bone? Will a trinket restore the Horde to its glory?

698.name: Lack of Surplus
desc: Bring 8 Unprepared Sawtooth Flanks to Tok'Kar in Swamp of Sorrows.
objectives: Bring 8 Unprepared Sawtooth Flanks to Tok'Kar in Swamp of Sorrows.
details: I'm working on getting some supplies together for our outpost near the beach to the east--Tok'kar does what he can, but between shifts of guard duty and cooking for his soldiers there's not much time left in the day.
BThey do enjoy cooking up some sawtooth meat when they can, but I haven't had time to get them another shipment. Would you mind helping them out?
BThe young sawtooths aren't as tasty as the older ones, so stay clear of those; give them a year or two to get to full size.
completion: Ah! Wonderful. Fresh meat for the fire tonight. Thank you, $N.
BYou've helped make the coming nights more tolerable. The fire burns bright, and our stomachs will be full.
BIts a pleasant surprise to have you bring us a shipment; Dar's not the most attractive orc anyone's laid eyes upon, but at least his attitude reeks far less than his smell.

722.name: Amulet of Secrets
desc: Find Hammertoe's Amulet and return it to him in Uldaman.
objectives: Find Hammertoe's Amulet and return it to him in Uldaman.
details: Ye're brave... <cough>... to come into Uldaman fer me, $c.
BIf ye're really here to help... ol' Hammertoe, then... <cough>... you'll need to find... me amulet.

BDeepshadow's got it... Magregan Deepshadow. He's 'round here... in the ruins fer sure. That amulet'll lead 'em... <cough>... right to the scrolls if he ain't stopped. It's up to you, $N. Please... get that amulet.
BThe scrolls will surely help the Dark Irons create even more powerful golems. I just know it. I can feel it in me bones.
completion: Ha! <cough cough>
BAh knew you'd find me amulet, $N.
B<weeze> Well done indeed, $N. <cough>

746.name: Dwarven Digging
desc: Collect 5 Prospector's Picks.
At a forge, smash the Prospector's Picks to create Broken Tools.
Bring 5 Broken Tools to Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village.
objectives: Collect 5 Prospector's Picks.
BAt a forge, smash the Prospector's Picks to create Broken Tools.
BBring 5 Broken Tools to Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village.
details: There are dwarves preparing a dig site to the northwest. They think secrets lie in the earth, and that is true, but hollowing and defiling the land is no way to earn its teachings.
BCollect the dwarven tools of digging, smash them, and return to me with the dwarves' broken tools.
BYou can smash the tools at a forge. You will find one in Thunder Bluff, but any forge -- even a forge at the dwarven camp -- will suffice.
completion: Thank you, $N. This will calm the beasts of Mulgore. And, spirits willing, it will teach the dwarves that hollowing the land is not the path to knowledge.

770.name: The Demon Scarred Cloak
desc: Find someone who knows of Ghost Howl.
objectives: Find someone who knows of Ghost Howl.
details: The ragged hide of Ghost Howl still bears a terrible wound, gained from the wolf's battles against the Burning Legion.
BPerhaps someone in Bloodhoof Village should know of Ghost Howl's demise....
completion: I can barely believe my old eyes! You defeated the great wolf Ghost Howl? I look upon you with new respect, young $C. You are a $C of extreme skills!
BLet me offer you something. My days of hunting are over, but I would be honored if you used one of my weapons in your hunts.
BMay it strike true, and bring you renown.
BAnd let us hope that Ghost Howl's spirit has finally found peace.

794.name: Burning Blade Medallion
desc: Bring the Burning Blade Medallion to Zureetha Fargaze, outside The Den.
objectives: Bring the Burning Blade Medallion to Zureetha Fargaze, outside The Den.
details: Through my divinations, I see that an item of power hides deep within the Burning Blade Coven, guarded by beasts and black magic.
BIt is called the Burning Blade Medallion, and your next task is to find it and remove it from the coven.
BBut be wary, for the medallion may be possessed by an agent of the Burning Blade, and if so then the agent's power would be greater than the familiars you have already encountered.
BGo, $N. You will find the coven in a cave, to the north and west.
completion: You retrieved it! Well done!
BYour efforts within the Burning Blade Coven are key in rooting out this cult in the Valley of Trials. But I fear they have further aims in our land.
BWe have not seen the end of them.

818.name: A Solvent Spirit
desc: Bring 4 Intact Makrura Eyes and 8 vials of Crawler Mucus to Master Vornal in Sen'jin Village.
objectives: Bring 4 Intact Makrura Eyes and 8 vials of Crawler Mucus to Master Vornal in Sen'jin Village.
details: Although my eyes fail me, I still can see clearly enough. More often I must rely on my alchemical skills to aid me in magics that once came easily. But I refuse to take on an apprentice--no troll or orc worthy enough has ever come forward.
BAre you worthy? Yes, of course you are... of course you think you are.
BI need a few things. Will you get them for me?
BI need intact makrura eyes, and vials of crawler mucus. You can find them on any makrura or crawler in Durotar. We shall speak again soon.
completion: Well done, young one... well done indeed.

842.name: Crossroads Conscription
desc: Follow the western road from Kargal's Far Watch Outpost.
At the T intersection, turn left and follow the road south.
Find Sergra Darkthorn at the crossing of roads within the Crossroads.
objectives: Follow the western road from Kargal's Far Watch Outpost.
BAt the T intersection, turn left and follow the road south.
BFind Sergra Darkthorn at the crossing of roads within the Crossroads.
details: Take this signed recruitment letter to the Crossroads.

BSergra Darkthorn, curse her hide, is in charge there. She's a nasty shaman who will talk your head in circles before she lets you do anything useful. Thrall is convinced she's something special, but I'm not so sure.
BYou'll just have to decide for yourself, pup...
completion: Alright, $N. You want to earn your keep with the Horde? Well there's plenty to do here, so listen close and do what you're told.

B$GI see that look in your eyes, do not think I will tolerate any insolence. Thrall himself has declared the Hordes females to be on equal footing with you men. Disrespect me in the slightest, and you will know true pain.:I'm happy to have met you. Thrall will be glad to know that more females like you and I are taking the initiative to push forward in the Barrens.;

866.name: Root Samples
desc: Bring 8 Root Samples to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
objectives: Bring 8 Root Samples to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
details: The herbs of the Barrens are not quite like herbs in other lands. Their properties are mostly the same, but the oasis water here alters the plants; they are just slightly different.
BI want to study those differences... to see if they're exploitable!
BIf you are skilled in herbalism, then gather root samples off the herbs you find in the Barrens. Bring back these samples so that I may compare them with herbs from other regions.
completion: Yes yes, these are very nice! I will grow specimens from these roots and study them. I hope to find new properties from them. Hidden, valuable properties...!
BAnd don't worry -- if I do then you'll be the first to know. Because I'll need someone to gather more!

890.name: The Missing Shipment
desc: Bring Gazlowe's Ledger to Wharfmaster Dizzywig.
objectives: Bring Gazlowe's Ledger to Wharfmaster Dizzywig.
details: I've been waiting forever for my last shipment of goods from Booty Bay! I'm pretty sure that it must have been stolen by the Freebooters, but just to make sure, will you go down to the dockside and ask Dizzywig if my goods were already put into my warehouse without my knowledge?
BHere, take my ledger down to Dizzywig and have him double check my inventory records against his logs.
completion: Ah, Gazlowe sent you, did he? Just a moment, let me take a look here and check my own logs and make sure I didn't have Gazlowe's shipment sent to the wrong place.
BBet he's waiting for those boots from Drizzlek...

914.name: Leaders of the Fang
desc: Bring the Gems of Cobrahn, Anacondra, Pythas and Serpentis to Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.
objectives: Bring the Gems of Cobrahn, Anacondra, Pythas and Serpentis to Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.
details: The druids in the Wailing Caverns, the Druids of the Fang, are an aberration. They were part of an order of noble druids whose plan was to heal the Barrens, but now seek to remake that land to match their own, twisted dreams.
BThe Druids of the Fang have four leaders, and each possesses a dream gem. Even now their faces haunt me! Defeat the leaders and bring me their gems, and the Barrens may again know peace.
BGo, $N. You will find them lurking deep within the Wailing Caverns.
completion: You have done it, $N. You killed the leaders of the Druids of the Fang. My dreams are now free of their wicked faces, and you have helped save the Barrens from a cursed future.
BI thank you, $N. I thank you for myself, for the druids of Thunder Bluff, and for the land.

938.name: Mist
desc: Escort Mist to Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak at the moon well near the Oracle Tree.
objectives: Escort Mist to Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak at the moon well near the Oracle Tree.
details: The sabercat's fur is a distinctive gray color, blending into the surrounding forest. As she lays there, you observe that she is badly wounded, with deep lacerations across her back and stomach.
BShe raises her head and gazes at you, bright intelligence shining in blue eyes. She seems to wish to follow you.
completion: Oh, thank you, $n! I feared I would never see Mist again, knowing only her death in my heart, never to be united with my faithful companion. I owe you more than you can know, and you have my eternal gratitude.

962.name: Serpentbloom
desc: Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff wants you to collect 10 Serpentbloom.
objectives: Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff wants you to collect 10 Serpentbloom.
details: The Royal Apothecary Society, based in the great Undercity of Lordaeron, has sent me here for a very specific service, $n. Perhaps you wish to aid me, and in turn The Dark Lady in our efforts to advance the Forsaken.
BRecently I studied a rare specimen of flora named Serpentbloom. I believe in greater quantities this herb has great potential.
BUnfortunately Serpentbloom can only be found in the darkest recesses of the Wailing Caverns, a dangerous cave system located in the Barrens.
completion: Ah, splendid specimens. You have done well, $N.

986.name: A Lost Master
desc: Find 5 Fine Moonstalker Pelts and return them to Terenthis in Auberdine.
objectives: Find 5 Fine Moonstalker Pelts and return them to Terenthis in Auberdine.
details: $N, your skills have already helped me in my endeavor. Could I impose on you again to help Grimclaw and his master Volcor? In addition, I can craft you a magical cloak that will allow you to walk unhindered by Darkshore's creatures while you look for him.

BTo create the cloak, I'll need five fine moonstalker pelts from a moonstalker sire or matriarch to have enough material. The cats can be found near Wildbend River to the south, or even farther south near Ashenvale.
completion: These will do nicely, $N. I shall set to work on the cloak immediately.
BGive me a few moments, then return to me.

BOh, one more thing: after you've used the enchantment on the cloak you'll be limited in your interactions with others. If you can help it, do no more than speak to others. Much more than that could dispel the illusion.

1010.name: Bathran's Hair
desc: Bring 5 Bathran's Hair to Orendil Broadleaf in Ashenvale.
objectives: Bring 5 Bathran's Hair to Orendil Broadleaf in Ashenvale.
details: There is a plant that once grew in the old ruins of Bathran's Haunt to the north. The plant was called Bathran's Hair and was known to cure ailments of the spirit.

BThere is a sick child in the village, and I believe it is more than just a physical illness. Will you go to Bathran's Haunt and search it for Bathran's Hair? I may need it to properly treat the child.
BBathran's Haunt lies north of Maestra's Post and just south of the border to Darkshore.
completion: Ah, you have the hair! Now I will mix a cure for the child, and pray my concoction works.
BAnd... Forsaken are at Bathran's Haunt? Very troubling to hear, that is. Very troubling indeed...

1034.name: The Ruins of Stardust
desc: Bring 5 Handfuls of Stardust to Pelturas in Astranaar.
objectives: Bring 5 Handfuls of Stardust to Pelturas in Astranaar.
details: Elune's Tear washed clear some of my daughter's sickness. Her nightmares are lessened and I thank the goddess for her blessing. But ... fever still rages within her.
BOrendil told me of a frosted dust found among the Ruins of Stardust. Perhaps it will abate Relara's fever. Gather some of the dust, then please return to me.
BThe Ruins of Stardust lie to the south, $N. May Elune speed your journey.
completion: You gathered the dust! I will create a poultice from these -- it should bring down Relara's fever.
BThank you again, $N. Without your help, my child would surely perish.

1058.name: Jin'Zil's Forest Magic
desc: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil at Malaka'jin wants 5 portions of Stonetalon Sap, 5 Twilight Whiskers, 30 Courser Eyes and a Fey Dragon Scale.
objectives: Witch Doctor Jin'Zil at Malaka'jin wants 5 portions of Stonetalon Sap, 5 Twilight Whiskers, 30 Courser Eyes and a Fey Dragon Scale.
details: So excited I am!
BThree little cages for three little elves! But what shall we do with our lovely tree-hugging friends? Why, let's give them a taste of... what do they call it... forest magic!

BI'll need a good mess of Stonetalon sap. From those horrid felines, bring me some twilight whiskers. This calls for plenty of courser eyes, of course -- can never have enough eyes. Oh, and lest we forget, a precious scale from a fey dragon.
BHurry to Stonetalon Peak, $n, so I can brew some forest magic!
completion: Oh how happy these little woodland nymphs shall be! We'll make them feel right at home with this special concoction!

1082.name: Update for Sentinel Thenysil
desc: Return to Sentinel Thenysil in Ashenvale.
objectives: Return to Sentinel Thenysil in Ashenvale.
details: $N, you have done a great deed by lending a hand here.
BThe Sentinels of Ashenvale will reward you well if you informed them that Gaxim and I are alive. Tell them we are well on our way to stopping the Venture Co. and healing the lands.
BFind Tara Thenysil in Astranaar; she will be pleased to see you've returned with good news.
completion: Thank you, $N. You have done a service to the Sentinels.
BI'm glad to see Kaela... and even Gaxim, are doing well.
BYou've earned our appreciation.

1106.name: Martek the Exiled
desc: Bring Fizzle's Letter to Martek the Exiled in the Badlands.
objectives: Bring Fizzle's Letter to Martek the Exiled in the Badlands.
details: I'm developing a new engine that'll make the car go so fast! Fast enough to fly, I know it! I just need to make pistons that can handle very very heavy stress. All my trials have failed because I can't make pistons hard enough!
BBut there is someone who might know how.
BHis name is Martek the Exiled. He is a great smith and knows more about metal than anyone. Take him this letter, I know he can help!
BBut he's far far away -- in Azeroth, in the Badlands, in a camp, with a goblin!
BFind him!
completion: Fizzle sent you? Well that changes things! Of course I'll help you. Fizzle and his brother are two of the few people who don't want me dead!
BSo Fizzle wants to make pistons, eh? Pistons strong enough to take whatever stresses he has planned, and if I know Fizzle, then this new car of his is a volcano on wheels!

1130.name: Melor Sends Word
desc: Speak with Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
objectives: Speak with Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
details: $N, Melor Stonehoof has heard of your deeds, and has set a path before you.
BIf you wish to take it, then go to Thunder Bluff and speak with Melor. You will find him on Hunter's Rise.
completion: So, $N, you have come. Now, are you prepared to journey through distant lands?
BIf so, young $C, then listen on...

1154.name: Test of Lore
desc: Find the Legacy of the Aspects and return it to Braug Dimspirit near the entrance to Talondeep Path in Stonetalon Mountains.
objectives: Find the Legacy of the Aspects and return it to Braug Dimspirit near the entrance to Talondeep Path in Stonetalon Mountains.
details: You have passed Dorn's tests, and now you seek to pass your next trial. Very good. But up until now, your challenges have been childish. It is easy to test your body--your mind is another matter completely.
BI shall explain it simply: find the book I name, study it, and answer my question about its contents.
BWhat book, you must be asking? The Legacy of the Aspects. It can be found at the bottom of Dor'danil in southern Ashenvale, protected by the dead druids and their slayers.
completion: This is the book I named. There is hope you will answer my question correctly then... unless you've forgotten to study its contents.
BWhen you are prepared, speak to me again and I shall ask a question of you.

1178.name: Goblin Sponsorship
desc: Speak to Gazlowe in Ratchet.
objectives: Speak to Gazlowe in Ratchet.
details: Our racing team is the pride of goblins everywhere. You'd be surprised at some of the people who contribute in one way or another to our team.
BYou know Gazlowe? He tracks down parts from around the world for us. He even came down to work on one of our rigs once!

BA few weeks ago, he said he'd send us a new prototype fuel regulator but it hasn't come yet. He's usually very prompt... Maybe you wouldn't mind going to Ratchet to ask him about it? I wouldn't be so pushy, but the gnomes are gaining on us!
completion: Pozzik sent you, huh? You know, Pozzik was one of the most respected tinkerers in Undermine before he retired to start working on the racers.

BThe first thing he did when he joined the team was develop the two engine model racers. Could be that the businesses will suffer without him working with the Tinkers' Union, but who cares, right? There's nothing like the races!

1202.name: The Theramore Docks
desc: Bring the Captain's Documents to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.
objectives: Bring the Captain's Documents to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.
details: $N, two of our spies were sent to steal documents from a ship at the Theramore docks. They gained the papers but were discovered, and were forced to throw the documents into the sea.
BOne spy later escaped, but was unable to recover the prize. He reported his failure to me, and I now charge the task to you.
BThe documents are in a footlocker, in the waters somewhere beneath the Theramore docks. Find those documents, $N, and bring them to me.
completion: I commend you, $N. This was not an easy mission. But the documents you gained are valued greatly by our superiors.

1250.name: The Missing Diplomat
desc: Speak to Mikhail in the Wetlands.
objectives: Speak to Mikhail in the Wetlands.
details: The Defias didn't pay me well enough to die for their cause. They took the king. Yeah, the king of Stormwind, not some lowly diplomat. He was on his way to Theramore to meet with Jaina Proudmore--it was a big deal apparently, and a big secret. But it's not just the Defias that are involved. They're working with someone. I think they knew this was bigger than them.
BMy part was just to get their man on board the king's ship while it was in the harbor. The guy's name was Hendel. That's all I know. I swear!
completion: THE KING?! I mean... the king? The real king? Are you joking? You didn't mention you were looking for the king's kidnappers. I didn't even hear he was missing--that would explain his son being crowned some.
BI'll send word to Elling right away. He'll want to know you're on the trail.
BI would never have guessed Jahn would sell out Stormwind for some lousy coin. Even a rogue's got to have honor when it comes to some things.
BThe key now is to find this Hendel. And I think I can help with that.

1274.name: The Missing Diplomat
desc: Find Bishop DeLavey in Stormwind Keep.
objectives: Find Bishop DeLavey in Stormwind Keep.
details: Excuse me, $g sir : madam;. Bishop DeLavey asked me to approach adventurers that might be able to help him with a delicate matter.
BIf you could quietly head to Stormwind Keep and speak to him at your earliest convenience, I'm sure he would appreciate your help. Again, please be discreet. It is a matter of some importance.
completion: Hello, $N. I am Bishop DeLavey.
BNo doubt if you're asking me about my business here in the keep then young Thomas has succeeded in requisitioning you to help our kingdom. He has always been adept at following my requests.
BI'm afraid I don't have time to elaborate much, so allow me to be blunt... and please, try to keep this from becoming common knowledge.

1322.name: The Black Shield
desc: Acquire 5 Acidic Venom Sacs for Do'gol in Brackenwall Village.
objectives: Acquire 5 Acidic Venom Sacs for Do'gol in Brackenwall Village.
details: Hmmm, there's writing right here on the rim of the shield, but it's hard to read from all the burned stuff.

BI need acid to make it clear. Venom from the darkmist spiders would do good. The spiders have taken over an old mine, the Darkmist Cavern, northwest of the village. Get me some of their sacs and I can clean this up.
completion: I don't like spiders that are so big I can't sit on them and squish them.
BThanks for getting them, $n. Now I rip them open and pour them onto the shield...

1370.name: Stealing Supplies
desc: Bring 6 bags of Crudely Dried Meat to Uthek the Wise in the Gelkis Village.
objectives: Bring 6 bags of Crudely Dried Meat to Uthek the Wise in the Gelkis Village.
details: When we are not at war, we hunt for meat. Meat gives us strength, and full bellies fight harder than empty ones.
BIt is the same with the Magram. They store extra meat so they may fight longer between hunts. If you raid their village to the east and take their stores of meat, then their strength will fail.
completion: Good. I can hear the loud Magram bellies grumble from their village, far away!
BI will give this meat to the Gelkis. And we will fight for many days without rest.
BWhat you did is good for the Gelkis, $N.

1394.name: Final Passage
desc: Speak to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles.
objectives: Speak to Dorn Plainstalker in Thousand Needles.
details: You have done well, $N. You have passed my test, and the tests before mine. Return to Dorn in Thousand Needles. He will sense the change within you, and see that your mind, body and spirit are strong enough that you should be rewarded for your efforts.
BStay true to the balance you've shown throughout these trials, $N. Dorn will test you again in the future if you do.
completion: Ah, $N. It has been a long time since you have last stepped into my home. It seems like many moons have passed since you took your first leap that set you upon your path.
BAnd now you return to me stronger than you once were... more enlightened. This pleases me. And you should be justly rewarded for seeing my tests to the end.

1418.name: Neeka Bloodscar
desc: Speak with Neeka Bloodscar.
objectives: Speak with Neeka Bloodscar.
details: The Badlands is harsh and lies close to the Alliance-held land of Loch Modan, so communication between Stonard and the Badlands outpost of Kargath is often cut.
BProve yourself, $N. Travel to the Badlands and speak with Neeka Bloodscar, head scout of the Kargath outpost. Speak with her, and then send her report back to me.
completion: Helgrum wants a report, eh? I sent an outrunner to Stonard not three days past. Did he fail his mission? If Stonard does not have my report, then it appears he did fail.
BLet's hope the next runner I send has more skill, or more luck.

1466.name: Reagents for Reclaimers Inc.
desc: Bring 10 Felhound Brains, 10 Nether Wings, and 10 vials of Doomwarder Blood to Kreldig Ungor in Desolace.
objectives: Bring 10 Felhound Brains, 10 Nether Wings, and 10 vials of Doomwarder Blood to Kreldig Ungor in Desolace.
details: This is the last of the items, and I won't lie, it ain't pretty. I'm also expecting this to take you a little bit longer than the other items.

BSo, enough with the warning, let's get this started. Leftwitch says he needs: ten brains from either mana eaters, mage hunters, or ley hunters. Ten nether wings from a nether maiden, sister or sorceress. And... ten vials of doomwarder blood from a doomwarder captain, or lord.
BSimple enough, huh? Sheesh... if you wanna pass on this one, I'd understand.
completion: Honestly? I wouldn't have thought it. You're amazing, $N. Taking on demons for a mage's experiments, and coming back in one piece to boot. Great job!
BI'm personally gonna tell Roetten about you when I get back to Ironforge.

1490.name: Nara Wildmane
desc: Speak with Nara Wildmane.
objectives: Speak with Nara Wildmane.
details: I entered the land of dreams, and dreamed of a cult of druids who dwell in the Wailing Caverns. I saw that their goals were once noble, but they have lost their way. They are now servants of the taint seeping through the Barrens.

BI am old and my strength fails. I could not long dwell in that dreaming place and know little more of the tainted druids. But Nara is young and her spirit is fierce. She remained in the dreaming when I fled.
BSpeak with Nara. She is in the tent, over yonder.
completion: Yes, it is true. I know of the druids in the Wailing Caverns. I have seen their twisted, scaled faces. I know their crimes, and I know their plans.
BYou must stop them, $N.

1658.name: Crashing the Wickerman Festival (PvP)
desc: Locate the Forsaken's Wickerman Festival in Tirisfal Glade. Return to Sergeant Hartman in Southshore once you've done so.
objectives: Locate the Forsaken's Wickerman Festival in Tirisfal Glade. Return to Sergeant Hartman in Southshore once you've done so.
details: I need brave individuals to head up to Tirisfal Glade and check out the Wickerman Festival. I'm not going to lie - heading up there will be dangerous. The guards at the festival will be exceptionally vicious. Still, we need to know how big the festival is this year, and how much trouble the Forsaken are going to cause us during Hallow's End.
BIf you're up for it, head to Tirisfal and scout out the festival. Return to me with the information, and I'll make sure you're well compensated.
completion: Well done, $N. The Wickerman Festival will continue to be trouble so long as the abominable Forsaken are allowed to haunt the remnants of Lordaeron. It is NOT a fitting tribute to that once proud kingdom, let me tell you...

BHere's some coin for any repairs you might need, and in the spirit of the season I've also included some treats you might like. Happy Hallow's End - let's keep it as safe as possible here in Southshore.

1682.name: Grey Iron Weapons
completion: Here are some weapons, hot off the anvil and made with the new umbral ore you brought me!
BPlease, $N, take your pick!

1706.name: Grimand's Armor
completion: NULL

1778.name: The Tome of Divinity
desc: Speak to Tiza Battleforge in Ironforge.
objectives: Speak to Tiza Battleforge in Ironforge.
details: I'm going to see about making plans to return home soon. Hopefully, Stephanie is doing well back in Stormwind. I can't wait to see her again. Till next we meet, $c.
completion: So, you've returned so quickly, huh? And what pray tell have you accomplished in your time away from here?

BWere you able to help a noble cause? Perhaps you've learned the value of charity or some more about your obligations to the citizens of Azeroth. Tell me, who have you helped and how.... Impressive, $N, those are surely the actions of one who follows the Light.
BSuch sacrifice will always be rewarded in time.

1802.name: Tome of the Cabal
desc: Retrieve the Moldy Tome and Tattered Manuscript for Krom Stoutarm in Ironforge.
objectives: Retrieve the Moldy Tome and Tattered Manuscript for Krom Stoutarm in Ironforge.
details: It was lost, but there's some idea as to where it might be found.

BThere was only one copy ever made and it was vandalized at some point, a large portion of it ripped from the binding. Rumor has it that it somehow passed into the hands of the centaur of Thousand Needles.
BThe rest was lost off the coast west of Southshore, where it was to be transported to Menethil Harbor by boat. It never arrived.
BIn exchange for this knowledge, all I ask is that if you find it, bring it to me to see.
completion: Fantastic! Now I may join the ranks of the few that have spied its contents.
BI can't wait to further peruse this text. This is a great day, $N! If you will just allow me to glance at it before you leave. I'm sure that Strahad will be willing to send me a copy.

1898.name: The Deathstalkers
desc: Speak with Andron Gant in the Undercity.
objectives: Speak with Andron Gant in the Undercity.
details: The letter of introduction should be enough to convince Andron that you are the messenger he's been waiting for. I've met Andron before, he doesn't quite have the mental capacity to be that suspicious.
BLord Varimathras suspects that Andron has been providing aid to some other group. He wishes to know what organization this is and requires proof of it.
BI want you to speak with Andron, and obtain this information. You'll find him at his shop near the Apothecarium.
completion: Ah, yes, I've been expecting you. I have no doubt our mutual acquaintances are pleased with the information that I have provided so far?
BI suppose there's no point in asking you, I doubt they would burden you with this knowledge. Why place so much trust in the messenger, hm?

1946.name: Nether-lace Garment
completion: Here is your nether-lace, $n. It is both comfortable and durable, and holds the magic of the laughing sisters' hair.
BEnjoy, and if you find it amenable, please mention so to Deino. She is a mage on whose good side I wish to stay...

2138.name: Cleansing of the Infected
desc: Cleanse the forest of 20 Rabid Thistle Bears and return to Tharnariun Treetender in Darkshore.
objectives: Cleanse the forest of 20 Rabid Thistle Bears and return to Tharnariun Treetender in Darkshore.
details: As I had feared, the cure does not work.
BIt saddens me greatly to order the death of any of nature's beasts, but the sick and tainted thistle bears must be put down.

BReturn to the forest and destroy 20 rabid thistle bears, $N. It will most certainly not put a stop to the plague but it will slow down the damage the animals are doing to our forest and its inhabitants for a short time.
completion: You have done Auberdine a great service, $N, but your task is not yet complete.

2258.name: Badlands Reagent Run
desc: Bring 5 Buzzard Gizzards, 10 Crag Coyote Fangs, and 5 Rock Elemental Shards to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath, Badlands.
objectives: Bring 5 Buzzard Gizzards, 10 Crag Coyote Fangs, and 5 Rock Elemental Shards to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath, Badlands.
details: $N, I could use your aid if you're up for it. I am an alchemist of some note, and I seek your aid in acquiring some reagents found out in the Badlands.

BI need the following items to replenish my stocks: five buzzard gizzards, ten crag coyote fangs, and five rock elemental shards. Obviously, you can get them off of the beasties themselves; if you're not the fighting type, then find friends who are.
BAcquire these items for me, you'll get some coin out of the deal. Watcha wanna do?
completion: Ah, well done! These should last me for a little while, at least. Here is your pay as promised.

BIf you're interested, I have some more reagents I could use. These, however, are only found in the depths of the Uldaman excavation. They will not be easy to get, but I will make it worth your while if you are interested in helping me again.
BPerhaps something more than some shiny coins, yes?

2282.name: Alther's Mill
desc: Open Lucius's Lockbox, recover the Token of Thievery and return it to Lucius in Lakeshire.
objectives: Open Lucius's Lockbox, recover the Token of Thievery and return it to Lucius in Lakeshire.
details: We've been training thieves here for years! After all, not every rapscallion is born with the grace and finesse of old Lucius.
BUp off the road here you'll find Alther's Mill. I got a chest up there with something important inside. Go get it for me! Bring back that token and you'll receive your Certificate of Thievery!
completion: Cracked it open, did you? Nice work, $N.
BIf you die now, we can rest easy knowing it was due to your own stupidity and not inexperience.

2378.name: Find the Shattered Hand
desc: Journey to Orgrimmar and speak with Shenthul at the Cleft of Shadow.
objectives: Journey to Orgrimmar and speak with Shenthul at the Cleft of Shadow.
details: You have served the Deathstalkers well, $N, but perhaps it is time for you to venture outward. While you have shown aptitude in the ways of stealth and deception, you still require much training.
BThe Deathstalkers have allies within the Shattered Hand. Seek out those that would assist us - find Shenthul in Orgrimmar.$B
completion: So, you are what our mighty allies have sent Shenthul? How uninspiring....

2498.name: Return to Denalan
desc: Rellian Greenspyre wants you to speak with Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.
objectives: Rellian Greenspyre wants you to speak with Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.
details: I have just received word that Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth has discovered what may be the cause of the tumors that plague the timberlings. Please speak with him, and tell him I sent you.
BMake haste, $N; he needs our help.
completion: Ah, so Rellian sent you to aid me. I am glad you arrived here so soon.
BI have discovered something quite disturbing!

2762.name: The Great Silver Deceiver
desc: Bring forty Mithril Bars and five Truesilver Bars to Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn.
objectives: Bring forty Mithril Bars and five Truesilver Bars to Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn.
details: It is said that truesilver is stronger and more durable than mithril. Galvan does not disagree with this assessment of the minerals, but contrary to its name, truesilver is not true! Mithril is a far nobler mineral! HAH! Regardless, for this lesson you will need to find the great silver deceiver, $N.
BBring me forty bars of mithril and five bars of truesilver. In exchange, you will be taught the secret of ornate mithril gloves and more importantly, learn that truesilver is a liar!
completion: She's a cruel mistress, is she not, $N? I'm speaking of truesilver, naturally. Aye, Galvan spent over a decade in the mountains of Alterac learning this lesson. Take this and learn from it all that you can!

2858.name: Wild Leather Boots
desc: Bring 2 Nightscape Pants, 2 Nightscape Boots, and 2 Wildvines to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.
objectives: Bring 2 Nightscape Pants, 2 Nightscape Boots, and 2 Wildvines to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.
details: Your knowledge of Wild Leather armor grows, $n; still, there is more for you to learn.

BWild Leather boots are the cornerstone of any set. Such boots are crafted to cradle the foot in comfort while bracing it against the hazards of adventuring. The soft soles are a blessing to those seeking quiet movement in footwear.
BFor this pattern, I need two Nightscape pants and two Nightscape boots crafted. I also will require two wildvines... not just one. When you have these items, we will proceed.
completion: Once again, you have produced items with the skill of a seasoned professional. You have earned this pattern, as well as my congratulations.

2930.name: Data Rescue
desc: Bring a Prismatic Punch Card to Master Mechanic Castpipe in Ironforge.
objectives: Bring a Prismatic Punch Card to Master Mechanic Castpipe in Ironforge.
details: When we fled Gnomeregan, we left so much data behind! Vitally important data!

BI need the data on a prismatic punch card, from a Matrix Punchograph 3005-D high security terminal, deep in Gnomeregan. You must access the terminal, but to do that you first need clearance... and to get that you must access lower security terminals-- models -A, -B and -C. And to do THAT you need security punch cards, starting with white... and we left all the punch cards in the city.
BIt's a catastrophe! Can you help?
completion: You did it! You found the prismatic punch card and recovered the lost data! Vitally, critically, immeasurably important data that we could not live another moment without!
BYour service to the gnomes will be long remembered, $N.

2954.name: The Stone Watcher
desc: Learn the purpose of the Stone Watcher of Norgannon, and then interact with the Uldum Pedestal in the Tanaris desert.
objectives: Learn the purpose of the Stone Watcher of Norgannon, and then interact with the Uldum Pedestal in the Tanaris desert.
details: "Salutations - I am a guardian of entry. Unless you have the Plates of Uldum already integrated with your disc set, I will not allow for entry into the Uldum compound."

BThe appearance of the Stone Watcher of Norgannon must be the reaction that was hoped for in sending you out to the Tanaris desert with the platinum discs. As instructed, you will need to find out what the story behind the Stone Watcher is before continuing on.
completion: The stone watcher's voice resonates with power and authority:
B"Your discs will be returned to you once you access the pedestal. When you have obtained the Plates of Uldum and incorporated them into your existing disc set, you may then enter the complex."

2978.name: The Gordunni Scroll
desc: Bring the Gordunni Scroll to Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache.
objectives: Bring the Gordunni Scroll to Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache.
details: Picking up the soiled scroll, you notice that it seems to be depicting some sort of meeting or ceremony. Rok Orhan would be interested in this scroll, and what it might mean to the Gordunni.
completion: This scroll... You found this in the Gordunni Outpost?

3002.name: The Gordunni Orb
desc: Bring the Gordunni Orb to Uthel'nay in the Darkbriar Lodge in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring the Gordunni Orb to Uthel'nay in the Darkbriar Lodge in Orgrimmar.
details: Although I know my enemy well, I am a warrior, $N. I cannot begin to tell you what this orb is capable of.
BI know of a mage in Orgrimmar that will be able to tell us more about the orb. Take it to him.
completion: Fascinating, $N...
BThis orb is very powerful, but also very dangerous.

3098.name: Glyphic Scroll
desc: Read the Glyphic Scroll and speak to Isabella in the church in Deathknell.
objectives: Read the Glyphic Scroll and speak to Isabella in the church in Deathknell.
details: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. I would think it's some matter of importance as it seems it bears the seal of the mage trainer Isabella. I would take some time to read it before heading out again.
completion: You must return to me often if you are to become powerful enough to destroy those who would oppose us. The rules of magic still apply to you, $N. You will still find corruption follows you like hungry wolves in the night. You will find its caress is not unlike an addiction, an old lover still wanting to be by your side. But these things can be staved off. These things will only control you if you allow them to.
BGo now, return to me when you've grown more powerful.

3122.name: Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i
desc: Deliver Neeru's Herb Pouch to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas.
objectives: Deliver Neeru's Herb Pouch to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas.
details: Here are the herbs, $N. Take them to Witch Doctor Uzer'i.
BPlease let him know that I am satisfied with the shrunken head.
completion: This is just what I need to prepare the muisek vessel, $N. Soon we will see if my latest incantations prove to be as powerful as I had hoped.
BPlease, a moment. I must perform the ritual and apply the herbs.

3362.name: Thistleshrub Valley
desc: Tran'rek in Gadgetzan wants you to kill 8 Gnarled Thistleshrubs and 8 Thistleshrub Rootshapers.
objectives: Tran'rek in Gadgetzan wants you to kill 8 Gnarled Thistleshrubs and 8 Thistleshrub Rootshapers.
details: Have you ever seen Thistleshrub Valley? It's a mighty dangerous place, $N.
BThose strange beasts there, I don't trust them for a minute! Gnarled thistleshrubs and thistleshrub rootshapers, that's what I think they were called...

BAnyhow, I want to get into the valley, but with so many of those thistleshrubs around, there's no way I'm going back there. But here's where you come in -- if you clear some of them out, I just might think about going back. What do you think, $N? Help me out?
completion: They're that big? I might have to rethink my plan...
BBut you did hold up your end of the bargain, so here's what I promised.

3506.name: Betrayed
desc: Destroy the arcane focusing crystal tied to Magus Rimtori and then slay her. Afterwards, take the Head of Magus Rimtori to Ag'tor Bloodfist in Azshara.
objectives: Destroy the arcane focusing crystal tied to Magus Rimtori and then slay her. Afterwards, take the Head of Magus Rimtori to Ag'tor Bloodfist in Azshara.
details: A few more moments of thought brings a few ideas to mind, one of which brings a smile to your face: perhaps destroying the crystals would upset the blood elf responsible for the slaughter of so many orcs and the betrayal of Belgrom?
BYou continue to decipher more of the script and pictures and realize that one of the crystals is tied to the creator of the circle--the others are tied to something far more sinister.
BYou close the book and begin to decide which crystal to destroy.
completion: RAR!! Incredible!
BYou've done it! Belgrom will be pleased! Finally the spirits of dozens of our warriors can be at peace. Thank you, $N.

3602.name: Azsharite
desc: Recover twenty Crystallized Azsharite from southern Azshara. You may use the Felhound to assist you in 'sniffing' out the location of cleverly hidden deposits.
Return to Loramus when the task is complete.
objectives: Recover twenty Crystallized Azsharite from southern Azshara. You may use the Felhound to assist you in 'sniffing' out the location of cleverly hidden deposits.
BReturn to Loramus when the task is complete.$B
details: The ancient cliff giants of the southern region of Azshara consume the rock and buildings of the land for sustenance. The excrement from their consumption is a highly malleable and extremely strong crystal known as Azsharite.
BThe formations litter the southern arc, but few are ever recovered due to the extremely violent nature of the giants.
BYou are to venture south and recover enough of the Azsharite for the creation of the weapon's body. My felhounds will aid in the recovery of the crystal.
completion: Your tasks in Azshara are complete, mortal. I must now forge the necessary components for the next step in your adventure.

3626.name: Return to the Blasted Lands
desc: Return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.
objectives: Return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.
details: The hour of redemption is near, $N. You must return to the Blasted Lands with your new-found weaponry and speak with the Fallen Hero of the Horde to receive your final objective.$B
completion: You look battle hardened, $N. Are you prepared to face Razelikh and his minions?

3842.name: A Short Incubation
desc: Bring 2 Elixir of Fortitudes to Quentin in Thousand Needles.
objectives: Bring 2 Elixir of Fortitudes to Quentin in Thousand Needles.
details: The Moonweavers, huh? Most intriguing. I wish the sprite darters could truly appreciate what it means to have those two look after them. They are both quite capable.

BSo, they gave you the egg as a gift. Well, then you should be responsible for it for as long as you desire. It appears it's almost ready to hatch, but we should ensure it's healthy and no damage has been done to it.
BI only need two elixirs of fortitude for a small spell to protect the egg. I have the rest of the components here with me.
completion: Wonderful. These will do nicely. Give me a moment to mix together my components and we shall see how well this egg is going to do.

3914.name: Linken's Sword
desc: Deliver Linken's Superior Sword to Linken in Un'Goro Crater.
objectives: Deliver Linken's Superior Sword to Linken in Un'Goro Crater.
details: After a strong flash of light, you are able to pick up the sword again. It has been transformed!
completion: My sword... It's finished!
BNow, if only I could remember why I needed this...
BHere, let me at least pay you for your work.

3962.name: It's Dangerous to Go Alone
desc: Travel to Fire Plume Ridge, south of Marshal's Refuge.
Find Blazerunner and use the totem to remove his protective aura. Once he has been defeated, acquire the Golden Flame from the cave.
objectives: Travel to Fire Plume Ridge, south of Marshal's Refuge.
BFind Blazerunner and use the totem to remove his protective aura. Once he has been defeated, acquire the Golden Flame from the cave.
details: $N, I finally remember now... I did come here to fight Blazerunner. I was on a journey, and this was to be the last step.
BBut I am no longer the hero... You are. All that you have done -- you must finish this now, not me.
BBlazerunner guards an artifact called the Golden Flame. It provides power more vast than anything else I have ever known, and it is dangerous in the hands of one with an evil heart.
BYou will want to bring others with you -- it's dangerous to go alone. Take this as my advice.
completion: Thank you, $N.
BThe Golden Flame will now be returned back to my homeland, where it may be protected, never again to be used for evil.
BSince you did so much for me, I'd like you to have this. Without you, I'd still have no idea who I am!

4082.name: KILL ON SIGHT: High Ranking Dark Iron Officials
desc: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors!
Warlord Goretooth wants you to kill 10 Anvilrage Medics, 10 Anvilrage Soldiers and 10 Anvilrage Officers. Return to him once your task is complete.
objectives: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors!
BWarlord Goretooth wants you to kill 10 Anvilrage Medics, 10 Anvilrage Soldiers and 10 Anvilrage Officers. Return to him once your task is complete.
details: By order of Warlord Goretooth, commander of the Kargath Expeditionary Force:

BHead of the K.E.F. reconnaissance division, Grandmaster Lexlort, has returned with news of the whereabouts of high ranking Dark Iron officials. Through locked gate, near the heart of the city, they train their forces to snuff out our men. Travel to Blackrock Depths and destroy them!
BCompletion of this mission will result in a tribute.$B
completion: Angerforge is undoubtedly... angry. Return to me when you receive a third tribute and we shall proceed with Operation: Death to Angerforge. I cannot go into any detail of what this entails, but rest assured, it involves somebody dying.

4130.name: Psychometric Reading
desc: Speak with Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold.
objectives: Speak with Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold.
details: I'm a little wobbly still, sorry. Anyway, I received some useful visions.

BRaschal takes two large leather backpacks from his boat and goes inland; he returns to the boat, however. I see gnoll scalps... he ran into some gnolls - Woodpaw I think they're called. He's very worried - almost terrified - about something. So much so, that he is not paying attention to water elementals forming behind him. The images... stop there.
BI need to rest, sorry $N. Tell Gin what I've seen. He needs to know.
completion: Thanks for passing along Quint's visions to me, $N. I'll try to remember to be a little easier on him the next time we play cards.

BRaschal can hold his own in a fight, and gnolls aren't anything that would get him worried - nay, terrified. Still, maybe you and yours can act on this new information and make the breakthrough we desperately need.

4298.name: Becoming a Parent
desc: Speak to Agnar Beastamer in the Hinterlands.
objectives: Speak to Agnar Beastamer in the Hinterlands.
details: Whoa, it was a lot more ready than I thought...
completion: Here, take the egg... better you have it so it bonds to you and looks to you to be its $gdadda:momma;.
BCongrats, $N. You're a parent... kinda.

4322.name: Jail Break!
desc: Help Marshal Windsor get his gear back and free his friends. Return to Marshal Maxwell if you succeed.
objectives: Help Marshal Windsor get his gear back and free his friends. Return to Marshal Maxwell if you succeed.
details: We need to get out of here, $N. Help me get my gear back from the supply area and free my friends. If we make it out of here, you are to proceed to Morgan's Vigil and speak with Marshal Maxwell. He will give you further instruction.
completion: Amazing, $N. Simply amazing. Windsor stormed through here not five minutes ago. He makes some grand claims but purports that they are supported by his evidence. He is on his way to Stormwind now to confront Bolvar and ... Lady Prestor.

4442.name: Purified!
desc: Speak to Eridan again in a moment.
objectives: Speak to Eridan again in a moment.
details: Using the water of Elune, I will attempt to purify the flute. We must end this suffering...
BMay Elune guide my hands and heart.
BSpeak with me again in a moment.
completion: With the blessed water, I was able to break the link between the flute and the ancient spirit. I do believe though, that if you were to use this flute in a sacred spot, you may be able to summon the ancient spirits.

BPerhaps you might try the ruins in the southern part of Irontree Woods. Many corrupted treants inhabited this area at one time, and it is possible that they may still reside there, even in spirit form.

4490.name: Summon Felsteed
desc: Speak to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet to learn the ability to summon a Felsteed.
objectives: Speak to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet to learn the ability to summon a Felsteed.
details: I would give you a reward for your patience and hard work. But know this, the ability to summon a Felsteed will be much more difficult in the future. You will have to earn it... and it will not be easy.
BFor now, go with the power to summon such a creature and use it as you see fit.
completion: Good luck, $N. I look forward to seeing you in the future.

4730.name: Beached Sea Creature
desc: Take the Sea Creature Bones to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
objectives: Take the Sea Creature Bones to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
details: The half-devoured corpse of what might have been a giant sea mammal lies on the beach. A band of murlocs, stronger than those found closer to Auberdine, have taken up residence around the fallen creature. Enough of the creature remains that a suitable sample of its bones could be delivered to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
completion: The bones you have are from gentle sea mammals that are known to inhabit the waters surrounding the base of Teldrassil. They had never been known to violently beach themselves like the threshers had been known to. Why would these creatures do this, I wonder? Well, perhaps the study of their remains will bear the fruits of knowledge that we seek.
BAgain, thank you for your aid. Please accept this honorarium from the Temple of the Moon.

5066.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
desc: Seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist. His base camp is located at Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains.
objectives: Seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist. His base camp is located at Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains.
details: Hear ye, hear ye! All heroes are called upon to heed these words!

BA call to arms has been issued by the Kingdom of Stormwind! All able bodied individuals are entreated to take up arms against the dark threat of the Scourge in the northern lands of the Eastern Kingdoms! Rumors fly of new threats rising from the ruins of the Plaguelands!
BHeroes of the realm - seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist who has set up his base camp in Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains!
completion: Welcome to the Plaguelands, hero. This is one of most dangerous frontiers in Azeroth, especially with the looming threat of the Scourge to our north and northeast. I am glad to hear that the clarion call of duty and service to the greater good did not fall on deaf ears with you!
BIf you are ready to get your hands dirty, then there is plenty for willing and able heroes to do here on the edge of the Plaguelands.

5090.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
desc: Seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist. His base camp is located at Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains.
objectives: Seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist. His base camp is located at Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains.
details: Hear ye, hear ye! All heroes are called upon to heed these words!

BA call to arms has been issued by the Kingdom of Stormwind! All able bodied individuals are entreated to take up arms against the dark threat of the Scourge in the northern lands of the Eastern Kingdoms! Rumors fly of new threats rising from the ruins of the Plaguelands!
BHeroes of the realm - seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist who has set up his base camp in Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains!
completion: Welcome to the Plaguelands, hero. This is one of most dangerous frontiers in Azeroth, especially with the looming threat of the Scourge to our north and northeast. I am glad to hear that the clarion call of duty and service to the greater good did not fall on deaf ears with you!
BIf you are ready to get your hands dirty, then there is plenty for willing and able heroes to do here on the edge of the Plaguelands.

5162.name: Wrath of the Blue Flight
desc: Speak with Jeziba in the Plaguelands. He resides in Andorhal.
objectives: Speak with Jeziba in the Plaguelands. He resides in Andorhal.
details: It is the arcane that I control and the arcane which will send you to your next destination.
BWhen you are ready, the journey will begin. To the Plaguelands you will go and to Jeziba you will speak.
BHe is a mortal as wise as the ancients and as patient as the immovable earth. Find him in Andorhal.$B
completion: I am Jeziba, known to many as the Sculptor. What I sculpt, however, are not statues, but heroes.
B

5210.name: Brother Carlin
desc: Bring the Extended Annals of Darrowshire to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.
objectives: Bring the Extended Annals of Darrowshire to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.
details: The Annals of Darrowshire, through my magic, has gained pages at its end, and now it extends its history beyond the battle. One of the extra passages tells of another Redpath, Carlin, who survived Joseph's betrayal. Carlin's now in the Plaguelands to the east, at the Light's Hope Chapel.
BTake the book and speak with him.
completion: What is this book? The Annals of Darrowshire? That was my home before the war... my home before the battle that destroyed it! Why did you bring me this book?
BBut look here! At the end there are pages that tell tales of the days beyond the battle! Here is a passage about me! And one about my brother Joseph! Is this book true?
BWe must discover the truth!

5234.name: Return to the Bulwark
desc: Bring the Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at The Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
objectives: Bring the Filled Writhing Haunt Bottle to Shadow Priestess Vandis at The Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
details: You delicately top off the empty bottle; a sample of the foul substance that churns under the platform of the cauldron now oozes back and forth inside the fragile glass container.
BWith the poison in hand, it is time to return to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark to complete the mission.
completion: Another finely executed mission, $N! This makes three cauldrons available to us to turn against the Scourge. If Kel'Thuzad's necromantic dominance over these lands wasn't as strong as it currently is, I'd dare say you'd shut them down completely!

BApothecary Dithers will have a report on what this cauldron - as well as the other cauldrons subverted - will require to deliver our counter agent to the plague. With that, the time has come to bring the last cauldron of the west under our influence!

5282.name: The Restless Souls
desc: Use Egan's Blaster on the ghostly and spectral citizens of Stratholme. When the restless souls break free from their ghostly shells, use the blaster again - freedom will be theirs!
Free 15 Restless Souls and return to Egan.
objectives: Use Egan's Blaster on the ghostly and spectral citizens of Stratholme. When the restless souls break free from their ghostly shells, use the blaster again - freedom will be theirs!
BFree 15 Restless Souls and return to Egan.
details: I draw my power - my will to continue living and breathing - from the unmitigated hatred I have for the Scourge and all that they have done. I am, however, no zealot. There are those, like the Scarlet Crusade, who would sooner destroy the innocent undead than lend them even an ounce of compassion.
BWhich brings me to this: My blaster. It will unchain the tortured souls from Stratholme.
BUse it on the ghosts that haunt the ransacked streets. Free their souls.
completion: <Egan wipes a tear from his eye.>
BDid you see my mother, $N? Did you free her?
BYou are a shining example of decency. For your troubles...

5306.name: Snakestone of the Shadow Huntress
desc: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Shadow Hunter Vosh'gajin. Recover Vosh'gajin's Snakestone and return to Kilram.
