objectives: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Shadow Hunter Vosh'gajin. Recover Vosh'gajin's Snakestone and return to Kilram.
details: Don't let her beauty fool you, $c. The shadow huntress, Vosh'gajin is deadly and deranged.
B<Kilram points to the scar on his face.>
BAye, she gave me that - a love tap, she called it.
BThe time for vengeance has finally come.
BYou can find Vosh'gajin in Blackrock Spire. Slay her and return to me with her snakestone. Do this and I will teach you the secret to crafting Dawn's Edge!
completion: Knowledge is power!

5522.name: Leonid Barthalomew
desc: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Leonid Barthalomew in the Eastern Plaguelands.
objectives: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Leonid Barthalomew in the Eastern Plaguelands.
details: I received a message from my master, Vectus. Well, the message wasn't really from Vectus...it was from someone named Leonid Barthalomew. I don't know Leonid, but he knew my master, and no one knows my master unless he allows it.
BLeonid says Vectus wants the dragon eggs. He wants you to deliver them to him at the Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
BThat hurts! Why you? Doesn't Vectus trust me? Oh, never mind... just take the eggs and tell Leonid that I did what our master commanded.
completion: Ah, very good. You do not know the evil power for whom you have labored, but now you will know the truth. And fear not--I am no servant of that master. I am Leonid Barthalomew, known as "the Revered" to my brethren in the Argent Dawn.

BI tricked Tinkee into sending you and the dragon eggs to me. And it is good that my trick was successful, for had these eggs reached their intended destination, a great power would have fallen into the hands of the enemy.

5642.name: Shadowguard
desc: Speak to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Speak to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.
details: Something important is up in Orgrimmar, $N.

BThe normal messengers that come through here looking for troll priests usually are very casual. This time, they seemed to be in much more a hurry. Don't dally too long in Thunder Bluff. I'd return to the Valley of Spirits as soon as possible.
completion: Your rites will come soon enough. For now, I teach you a spell that will be of great use to you when you do battle with your enemies.

5762.name: Hemet Nesingwary
desc: Take Kravel's Crate to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn.
objectives: Take Kravel's Crate to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn.
details: I have a package for an old customer of mine, a dwarf named Hemet Nesingwary. The package took weeks to arrive, and Hemet's long gone by now. He said he was going to Stranglethorn to hunt the beasts there, but he left me some money to send his delivery when I could.
BHemet's a rich dwarf and it's a good idea to keep up relations with the rich ones, yeah? So... you want to deliver the package for me?
BI heard Hemet has a camp in Stranglethorn, north of Grom'gol.
completion: Great, my package from Koalbeard! Thank you $N. This crate holds special-gauge ammunition, and it'll serve us well out in the jungle!
BHere's your pay, and tell me, how is crusty old Kravel these days? Still up to no good I'd wager...

5882.name: Salve via Hunting
completion: Very well then, here are your Cenarion plant salves. Scour Felwood for corrupted plants, $n! Wherever they are, use the salve I have given you to purify them.

5930.name: Great Bear Spirit
desc: Seek out the Great Bear Spirit in northwestern Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the bear. When finished, return to Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven, Moonglade.
objectives: Seek out the Great Bear Spirit in northwestern Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the bear. When finished, return to Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven, Moonglade.
details: In the northwest part of Moonglade resides the home of a wise and noble being we call the Great Bear Spirit. For all druids, it has served as a tutor and mentor into the first true natural understanding of the bear. All druids at one point seek the spirit's wisdom, and you shall be no exception.

BGo to the Great Bear Spirit now and learn what it will teach. When it is satisfied with you, return to me here in Nighthaven. We will then see if you have truly taken account of the lessons it teaches.
completion: Dendrite makes another invisible gesture in the air above him as you approach. Another aura of power comes over him. and he smiles ever so slightly.

B"I sense wisdom in you, young one, that was not present when we first met. You gaze upon me with strength and knowing intent, though this intent is yet not focused. You will now learn to focus your strength and adopt the nature of the bear into your work."

6002.name: Body and Heart
desc: Use the Cenarion Lunardust on the Moonkin Stone between Mulgore and the Barrens to bring forth Lunaclaw. From there, you must face Lunaclaw and earn the strength of body and heart it possesses.
Speak with Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff when you are done.
objectives: Use the Cenarion Lunardust on the Moonkin Stone between Mulgore and the Barrens to bring forth Lunaclaw. From there, you must face Lunaclaw and earn the strength of body and heart it possesses.
BSpeak with Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff when you are done.
details: On land west of Taurajo in the Barrens - just before it turns into Mulgore - lies a Moonkin Stone. The moonkin are special beasts, not native to these parts. Lunaclaw, the stone's defender, will face you when Cenarion Lunardust is applied to it. Lunaclaw possesses within it a strength that you must use as one of the Claw.
BYou've earned the right to use this Cenarion Lunardust, $N... now show me that you've earned the right to possess the strength of body and the strength of heart needed as a druid!
completion: You have finally taken your large step into a much larger world, $N. I sense the teaching of the Great Bear Spirit within you, and I sense that you have received the strength that Lunaclaw possessed.
BThere are no further obstacles in your way... let me now teach you what it means to be a Druid of the Claw!

6026.name: That's Asking A Lot
desc: Smokey LaRue wants you to get 2 Thorium Bars, 1 Golden Rod, 8 Hi-Explosive Bombs, and 8 Unstable Triggers.
You will have to find a blacksmith and an engineer for these items.
objectives: Smokey LaRue wants you to get 2 Thorium Bars, 1 Golden Rod, 8 Hi-Explosive Bombs, and 8 Unstable Triggers.
BYou will have to find a blacksmith and an engineer for these items.
details: These here Argent Dawn people commissioned ol' Smokey to do a little demolition work for 'em. Smokey's mammy ain't raised no dummy. When gold coin is slapped on the table, Smokey's services are available. That's my motto!

BNow I'd be willing to split the commission with you if you're willing to do a little legwork. Here's the deal: I'm going to head over to Plaguewood and mark the buildings we need destroyed. You gather the components for the bombs. Meet back here when you've got everything. Deal?
completion: I can pay you half up front and half when the job is done.

6074.name: The Hunter's Path
desc: Speak with Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.
objectives: Speak with Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.
details: Hello, young hunter. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.
BYou must see Grif Wildheart in Kharanos. He can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.
completion: Yes, I do believe you are ready, as well....

6122.name: The Principal Source
desc: Use the Empty Cliffspring Falls Sampler to draw a sample of water from the mouth of the cave by the falls.
Deliver the Filled Cliffspring Falls Sampler to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine, Darkshore.
objectives: Use the Empty Cliffspring Falls Sampler to draw a sample of water from the mouth of the cave by the falls.
BDeliver the Filled Cliffspring Falls Sampler to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine, Darkshore.
details: The Cliffspring Falls in Darkshore serves as the principal source of drinking water for the region, and now I suspect it is the principal source of the poison that is harming the local fauna - deer specifically. Use this sampler to draw some water from the mouth of the cave; be careful, as dangerous naga now reside in a cave by the falls.
BOnce filled, deliver it to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine. She is the one that requested our aid, and you will work with her to address this malady.
completion: By Elune, this water is disgusting! No wonder the deer are sick.

BSomething is polluting the water, and in turn corrupting Darkshore's entire water table. Sick deer have been seen all over area, and not just by the river. While this water is most likely a primary source of the sickness spreading, there's something else at work here.
BThis water, believe it or not, will help us formulate a cure. While I research this water, I have need of some items to formulate a cure...

6146.name: Nathanos' Ruse
desc: Travel to Tyr's Hand, southeast of the Marris Stead. Once there, take a bite of the Rotten Apple. While under the guise of the Scarlet Crusade, deliver the Grand Crusader's Command to Crusader Lord Valdelmar.
objectives: Travel to Tyr's Hand, southeast of the Marris Stead. Once there, take a bite of the Rotten Apple. While under the guise of the Scarlet Crusade, deliver the Grand Crusader's Command to Crusader Lord Valdelmar.
details: I have made some adjustments to this command. Should our little ruse work, they will expose the Scarlet Oracle and we shall strike!
BNow pay attention, $c. You are to deliver this command to the Crusader Lord, Valdelmar.
BHow? You are going to hand it to him, imbecile.

BTake the command and this rotten apple to Tyr's Hand. When you cross into the city, eat the apple. You will transform into something more... palatable to the humans. Take the command and hand it to the Crusader Lord, Valdelmar.
completion: Where have you been? We had thought the Scourge had captured you.

6362.name: Ride to Thunder Bluff
desc: Buy a wind rider to Thunder Bluff from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring the Bundle of Hides to Ahanu in Thunder Bluff.
objectives: Buy a wind rider to Thunder Bluff from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring the Bundle of Hides to Ahanu in Thunder Bluff.
details: For a small fee, I will give you a wind rider to Thunder Bluff. There's no faster way to the city!
BIf that is acceptable, speak to me again when you are ready to go.
BIf you're taking those hides to Ahanu, then I think he's at Hewa's Armory, at the base of the wind rider tower in Thunder Bluff. And that's right where you'll land!
completion: Ah, a new bundle of hides. I will get to work on these immediately!
BThank you, brother. You have done me a great service. Here are some coins to pay for your time and travel costs.

6386.name: Return to the Crossroads.
desc: Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Doras, then bring Gryshka's Letter to Zargh at the Crossroads.
objectives: Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Doras, then bring Gryshka's Letter to Zargh at the Crossroads.
details: My wind riders are trained to fly to many different places, as long as you have already been to that place and spoken with the wind rider master there.
BYou have been to the Crossroads and spoken to their wind rider master Devrak, so now you can fly directly to him from here. Once you're at the Crossroads, you can deliver Gryshka's letter to Zargh.
BSpeak with me when you are ready to go.
completion: Hah! I guess she liked it! Nothing brings red to a lady's cheeks like a big, juicy steak!
BThank you, $N. You've done me a great service. Here is some money for your trouble, and don't be surprised if I invite you to my wedding!

6482.name: Freedom to Ruul
desc: Escort Ruul, then speak with Yama Snowhoof in Splintertree Post.
objectives: Escort Ruul, then speak with Yama Snowhoof in Splintertree Post.
details: Eh? Who are you?
B$N? You're no furbolg. They are cursed! They thought I was a bear and captured me, and now they starve me! My strength is failing...
BHelp me escape, then speak with my sister Yama at the Splintertree Post to the east.
B$N! I must escape!
completion: You found my brother! He was captured by the Thistlefurs? That is terrible news to hear, for although many Furbolgs are noble creatures, the Thistlefurs are corrupt.
BThank you for rescuing my brother, $N. I do not want to think of how they treated poor Ruul. He will likely sleep long after this ordeal...

6602.name: Blood of the Black Dragon Champion
desc: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay General Drakkisath. Gather his blood and return it to Rexxar.
objectives: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay General Drakkisath. Gather his blood and return it to Rexxar.
details: How would you feel about paying a visit to the General? No illusions, this time.
BCeremony? A pretty word to describe the bloodletting that amuses the Black Dragonflight.
BAll this amulet requires is the blood of General Drakkisath. Primitive security. There are other ways to receive the General's blood.
BGo to Blackrock Spire and kill Drakkisath. Return with his blood and I will activate the key to Onyxia's lair.
completion: A victory that will be remembered for many years, $N. The Drakefire Amulet will open Onyxia's lair. Gather your allies and bring victory to the Horde.

6626.name: A Host of Evil
desc: Kill 8 Razorfen Battleguard, 8 Razorfen Thornweavers, and 8 Death's Head Cultists and return to Myriam Moonsinger near the entrance to Razorfen Downs.
objectives: Kill 8 Razorfen Battleguard, 8 Razorfen Thornweavers, and 8 Death's Head Cultists and return to Myriam Moonsinger near the entrance to Razorfen Downs.
details: The Forsaken do not pass on their... illness... from what I have seen. This diplomat seems to be granting undeath to would-be followers. I am beginning to think he is one of the Scourge.
BFor now, my concern is not with him though, it's with the growing ranks around him. They creep from the shadows daily, almost begging him for more power.
BI'm not powerful enough to fight them on my own, $N. What do you say? Are you up for some hunting?
completion: Thank you, $N! The work you've done will be a great help, I'm sure.

BI will continue my study of this diplomat and the rest of the quilboar here. If you seek greater adventure, I'd find a few friends and head into the cave that looks like a great boar maw just over there. I'm sure once you're inside you'll find greater challenges to face.

6722.name: The Hunter's Path
desc: Speak with Dazalar in Dolanaar.
objectives: Speak with Dazalar in Dolanaar.
details: Hello, young hunter. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.
BYou must see Dazalar in Dolanaar. He can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.
completion: Yes, it is time, $C.

6962.name: Treats for Great-father Winter
desc: Bring 5 Gingerbread Cookies and an Ice Cold Milk to Great-father Winter in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring 5 Gingerbread Cookies and an Ice Cold Milk to Great-father Winter in Orgrimmar.
details: Hey, can you do Great-father Winter a favor, um, little $g boy : girl;?

BNot to needlessly talk about myself in the third person, but Great-father Winter has been at this all day and he could use a treat himself. Some gingerbread cookies and ice cold milk to wash them down with would really hit the spot. Think you could be a friend to the Great-father and fetch some for me?
completion: You're quite the helper to ol' Great-father Winter there, $N. Have a great Feast of Winter Veil.
BHere's a little something... you know, for the effort.

7082.name: The Graveyards of Alterac
desc: Assault a graveyard, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.
objectives: Assault a graveyard, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.
details: The battle lines of Alterac Valley are ever shifting. Territories swing back and forth as we meet our opponents in deadly combat. And graveyards, $N, are where battles rage most fierce.
BI want you to attack an Alliance held graveyard! Find a graveyard with an Alliance banner in its midst and pull it from the ground.
BDo that and your task for me will be complete, but... if you hold the graveyard for a few minutes, then it will be ours and troops will come and relieve you.
completion: Well done, $N! With each graveyard under our control, the spirits of our enemies will wander more lost and aimless.

7202.name: Korrak the Bloodrager
desc: According to legend, the leader of the mighty Winterax trolls appears at will to wreak havoc on the denizens of Alterac Valley.
Should Korrak make himself known, destroy him and return to Lieutenant Haggerdin in the Alterac Mountains.
objectives: According to legend, the leader of the mighty Winterax trolls appears at will to wreak havoc on the denizens of Alterac Valley.
BShould Korrak make himself known, destroy him and return to Lieutenant Haggerdin in the Alterac Mountains.
details: The indigenous Winterax trolls of the region are ruthless savages that would love nothing more than to have our bones added to their foul stew.
BWe must show them our might!

BWe have recovered tomes from their caves that detail their leadership hierarchy. The artifacts indicate that their leader, Korrak the Bloodrager, tends to remain hidden until given a reason to make his presence known.
BDeath to Korrak would mean death to Winterax Clan! Slay him and return.
completion: NULL

7490.name: Victory for the Horde
desc: Take the Head of Onyxia to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Take the Head of Onyxia to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
details: You have accomplished the impossible. The brood mother of the Black Dragonflight lies dead at your feet. Take her head and present it to your Warchief.
completion: This is a great victory for the Horde, $N. So many times you have honored your Warchief. It is time for the Warchief to honor you.

7562.name: Mor'zul Bloodbringer
desc: Speak with Mor'zul Bloodbringer in the Burning Steppes.
objectives: Speak with Mor'zul Bloodbringer in the Burning Steppes.
details: $N, your delvings into the dark arts are deep. Your mastery over otherworldly denizens has grown so strong... perhaps you are ready to bind to you one of the infamous dreadsteeds.

BThe ritual to summon the beast from its home requires great power and resources, but if you desire to dominate that epic mount, then speak with Mor'zul Bloodbringer. He is camped near the Altar of Storms in the Burning Steppes.
BGo, $N. This quest will be perilous, but a Warlock of your stature does not shy from danger!
completion: Greetings, $N, and welcome. Are you here to study near the Altar of Storms as I am, perhaps to harness its energy for some hidden purpose...
BOr... are you here to speak with me? Yes, I believe you are.

BYou want to master a dreadsteed? Such is no easy task. It will cost you no small amounts of blood, sweat... and of course gold. But a dreadsteed of Xoroth is a prize well worth winning so if interested, listen on...

7634.name: Ancient Sinew Wrapped Lamina
desc: Hastat the Ancient has asked that you bring him a Mature Blue Dragon Sinew. Should you find this sinew, return it to Hastat in Felwood.
objectives: Hastat the Ancient has asked that you bring him a Mature Blue Dragon Sinew. Should you find this sinew, return it to Hastat in Felwood.
details: Greetings, $c. I am Hastat, Ancient of Lore. I hold knowledge lost eons ago.
BWith the proper binding, one of my leaves can serve as a quiver the likes of which has not been seen in 10,000 years. A quiver that when accompanied by a bow of Ancients, could grant untold powers.
BReturn here with sinew from an adult blue dragon and this quiver shall be yours.
completion: May my leaves provide your arrows protection from harm. May your arrows strike true. May the enemies of our world be smitten.

7658.name: Imperial Plate Leggings
completion: A pleasure doin' business with ya.
BAnd $N, wipe that look of disgust off yer face.

7730.name: Zukk'ash Infestation
desc: Bring 20 Zukk'ash Carapaces to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.
objectives: Bring 20 Zukk'ash Carapaces to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.
details: From what scouting we have managed to muster, we believe that the foe south of the gnolls is an insect-like race. Frankly, it is irrelevant whether or not if they're sentient. If they are driving the gnolls to frenzy against us, then they are as big of a threat - if not more - than the gnolls.

BDrive deep into where these Zukk'ash insects dwell; it is known as the Writhing Deep. Thin their numbers and report back to me what you find, bringing back their carapaces as evidence of your handiwork.
completion: Well done, $C. Though the extensiveness of the Zukk'ash presence will not be thwarted with anything less than a full-scale invasion, you have bought us some time so we can devise a proper strategy.
BI will be sure to have these carapaces analyzed; we'll need to learn everything about them before we deal with what has unfortunately turned into a much larger issue than we had anticipated.

7802.name: A Donation of Wool
completion: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, $N!

7826.name: A Donation of Wool
completion: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, $N!

7850.name: Dark Vessels
desc: Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover 10 Vessels of Tainted Blood from Jintha'alor. Return to Primal Torntusk when this task is complete.
objectives: Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover 10 Vessels of Tainted Blood from Jintha'alor. Return to Primal Torntusk when this task is complete.
details: The Vilebranch fight with supernatural ferocity. This is due to the foul magical weavings of the Vile Priestess Hexx.
BThroughout Jintha'alor you will find dark vessels of tainted blood. The vessels radiate the foul magic of the faceless blood God, empowering the Vilebranch and also driving them to madness.
BSteal those vessels and return them to me so that I may remove the taint and ultimately loosen the grip of the blood God.
completion: The dark energy that compels the Vilebranch has been lifted - for now. We must remain ever vigilant in our battle against evil, as even if the Vile Priestess is destroyed, another soon takes her place.

7874.name: Quell the Silverwing Usurpers
desc: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Alliance, gain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and bring it to Captain Shatterskull at the Mor'shan Base Camp.
objectives: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Alliance, gain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and bring it to Captain Shatterskull at the Mor'shan Base Camp.
details: The wilds of the Ashenvale forest will succumb to the might of the Horde, $r. Nothing the Silverwing say or do can stop our sovereign imperative. Kalimdor belongs to the Horde. How dare they attempt to prevent us from harvesting what is rightfully ours!

BLet the pride swell in your chest as you cut down their weak attempts at slowing our progress. Destroy the Silverwing Sentinels, and earn a Warsong mark of honor. Return to me with such a mark, $N, and you will be rewarded.$B
completion: <Captain Shatterskull roars in triumph.>
BHow much more can they withstand? How many more Alliance filth must perish at the hands of the Horde for them to retreat? Only time will tell, $R.

8042.name: Strength of Mount Mugamba
completion: Our paths will cross again, $c.

8066.name: Paragons of Power: The Predator's Belt
desc: Bring the following Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub to Falthir the Sightless: A Primal Hakkari Shawl. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.
Falthir the Sightless is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
objectives: Bring the following Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub to Falthir the Sightless: A Primal Hakkari Shawl. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.
BFalthir the Sightless is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
details: A predator knows how to stalk their prey, but a successful one knows how to strike at it once they have closed ranks. You must master both to have any chance of success in Zul'Gurub... and any chance of being like the Zandalar predators.

BBring me choice parts of the Paragons of Power from within Zul'Gurub. My reward will be the power that the trinkets yield, while yours will be the Zandalar predator's belt - equipment well worth the trade.
completion: I sensed your arrival moments before, $N, but none too easily. What revealed yourself to me were the Paragons of Power you brought. I can feel the power without needing to see the trinkets; their latent mojo - raw magic, if you will - will continue to fuel our efforts of vanquishing the diabolic schemes of the Blood God Hakkar.
BYou are to be commended - and rewarded - for your success. You are honored amongst the tribe, and you are worthy to wear the predator's belt.

8114.name: Control Four Bases
desc: Enter Arathi Basin, capture and control four bases at the same time, and then return to Field Marshal Oslight at Refuge Pointe.
objectives: Enter Arathi Basin, capture and control four bases at the same time, and then return to Field Marshal Oslight at Refuge Pointe.
details: $N, you have taken the battle of Arathi Basin to our enemies and earned great honors in that field of battle. You have shown us your worth as a $c, and you have shown our enemies that we will not submit to their villainy!

BBecause of your proven value to us, I have a difficult task for you. I want you to take and hold at least four of the bases in Arathi Basin. If you can do that, then we will not only secure critical resources, we will show the Horde our dominance!
BGo, $N, and good fortune.
completion: NULL

8162.name: Cut Arathor Supply Lines
desc: Win the battle for Arathi Basin, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Deathstalker Mortis at Hammerfall.
objectives: Win the battle for Arathi Basin, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Deathstalker Mortis at Hammerfall.
details: The League of Arathor is sparing no expense in their move to retake Arathi. They, and all the races of the Alliance, now stream to this distant region, intent on expanding their hold from Refuge Pointe. We must stop them, and the best means to stop them is to take their supplies.

BYou can help us, $N. Enter Arathi Basin, known for its rich mines, fertile land and skilled craftsman. Capture and control every base you can, win the battle, and return to me with the resources you gain.
completion: NULL

8234.name: Sealed Azure Bag
desc: Retrieve the Sealed Azure Bag from the Timbermaw Shaman in Azshara. Then take the bag to Archmage Xylem, also found in Azshara.
objectives: Retrieve the Sealed Azure Bag from the Timbermaw Shaman in Azshara. Then take the bag to Archmage Xylem, also found in Azshara.
details: First things first. What I've lost is a small blue bag, the contents of which are a private matter.

BDon't bother going after the thieves, because they are already dead. What we do know is the fools couldn't get the bag open. so they sold it to some timbermaw shaman in Azshara as a holy relic. Clever.
BI need you to travel to Azshara and retrieve it from the shaman through subtlety... or force. Better luck with the first method, I'd wager. Once acquired, take it to Archmage Xylem.
completion: I see you have Lord Ravenholdt's bag. Why didn't you say so, boy?

8258.name: The Darkreaver Menace
desc: Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance. Doing so will bring forth spirits you must fight. Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver; defeat him.
Bring Darkreaver's Head to Sagorne Creststrider in the Valley of Wisdom, Orgrimmar.
objectives: Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance. Doing so will bring forth spirits you must fight. Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver; defeat him.
BBring Darkreaver's Head to Sagorne Creststrider in the Valley of Wisdom, Orgrimmar.
details: Death Knight Darkreaver lords over the Great Ossuary in the Scholomance. He threatens to twist the spirit realm to do his own bidding, and he must be stopped! This is where the scryer you helped make comes into play.

BUse the divination scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement to call forth Darkreaver's spirit minions. Defeat the spirits and the death knight himself will appear. $N, bring me his head! Only his demise will reverse the damage done to the spirit realm!
completion: This is a victory to savor, $N! The demise of Darkreaver should restore the fragile fetters that anchor the spirit realm.
BYou have far exceeded what was asked of you, even when you had no notion of reward or compensation. You are truly a $C of worth, my friend.
BI know that acting to preserve the spirit realm should be thanks enough, but please - accept this simple gift with my thanks.

8282.name: Noggle's Lost Satchel
desc: Retrieve Noggle's Satchel from the mountains in the south of Silithus and return it to him at Cenarion Hold.
objectives: Retrieve Noggle's Satchel from the mountains in the south of Silithus and return it to him at Cenarion Hold.
details: Where am I? Where's my bag? *gasp* I must've lost it while fleeing from Deathclasp, the giant scorpid. In my rush to escape I walked right into a nest of stonelash flayers.

BThe satchel I was carrying had all sorts of rare reagents in it. Without them, me and Beetix won't be able to make the potions that Cenarion Hold needs. I'm too weak to get up yet, but I can make it worth your while if you bring back my reagents.
BI ran into Deathclasp in the southern mountain range, behind Bronzebeard's camp.
completion: Yes! You brought my satchel back. And my rare reagents are all here! I'll be in your debt for a long time.

8306.name: Into The Maw of Madness
desc: Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to find his beloved Natalia. The information that you gathered points to Hive'Regal in the south as being the area in which you may find Mistress Natalia Mar'alith.
Do not forget to visit the dwarves at Bronzebeard's camp before venturing into the hive. They might have some additional work and advice for you.
And $N, remember the Commander's words: "Do what you must..."
objectives: Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to find his beloved Natalia. The information that you gathered points to Hive'Regal in the south as being the area in which you may find Mistress Natalia Mar'alith.
BDo not forget to visit the dwarves at Bronzebeard's camp before venturing into the hive. They might have some additional work and advice for you.
BAnd $N, remember the Commander's words: "Do what you must..."
details: I need you to venture into Hive'Regal and find what became of my dearest Natalia, $N. This will be no easy task for you. Before you dive headlong into the maw of madness, make sure that you go back and speak with those dwarves. They might be able to give you some tips on dealing with the silithid that inhabit that hive.
BAnd $N, if she truly is as mad as they say... do what you must.
B<Commander Mar'alith turns away from you.>$B
completion: <Commander Mar'alith clutches at his chest.>
BC'Thun? WHAT is the meaning of all this? What is C'Thun? How could this fiend have turned my sweet Natalia into the monster that you described?

8378.name: Armaments of War
completion: War comes, $N, and with it comes untold horrors. You have done all that could be asked of you and for that you should be rewarded.
BShould this... this prophecy ever come to pass...
B<Geologist Larksbane turns pale.>
BThe future of us all could be at an end.
BThese armaments will prove invaluable to your campaign in this desert.

8402.name: Fight for Warsong Gulch
desc: Bring 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
objectives: Bring 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
details: The Silverwing Sentinels are at war with the Warsong Outriders due to the destruction the Orcs are causing to the forest. There are, however, more reasons to defend this particular forest than plain love for nature.
BThe forest forms a strategic barrier that makes Ashenvale defendable against a large-scale attack. Without it, Astranaar would last a day or two before being annexed to the Barrens.
BDo your part in fighting the Warsong Outriders, $N! For the Alliance!
completion: Well done, $N! You've served the Alliance well.

8426.name: Battle of Warsong Gulch
desc: Bring 3 Warsong Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
objectives: Bring 3 Warsong Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
details: The battle in Warsong Gulch against the Silverwing Sentinels is of great importance. Under the guise of protecting a forest that doesn't belong to them, the Alliance seeks to deny the Horde one of our largest sources for lumber.
BDo not let this happen, $N! Come back to me with proof of serving the Horde in a worthy manner!
completion: Excellent! You've shown your worth by defending our operations in Warsong Gulch! May word of your honor spread far and wide across our lands.

8522.name: The Alliance Needs Runecloth Bandages!
desc: Bring 20 Runecloth Bandages to Keeper Moonshade at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
objectives: Bring 20 Runecloth Bandages to Keeper Moonshade at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
details: Argue the merits of the war if you will, $c, but it has already been set in motion. Look around you at your family and friends, and then ask yourself what it is that you can do to see to it that if they are involved, they will have every advantage to survive the conflagration.
BTo that end, I am collecting runecloth bandages here from whatever source. Would you like to make a donation?
completion: You are to be commended, $C, for your perseverance in this task. I shall put these bandages away, and then I should like to talk to you again about the possibility of your collecting even more runecloth bandages.

8546.name: The Horde Needs More Mithril Bars!

8642.name: Silvervein the Elder
completion: It is good to know the people of this land still pay homage to the olden races. I bid you well, $N, and offer you this token...

8690.name: Cloak of the Gathering Storm
desc: Bring 1 Qiraji Regal Drape, 2 Obsidian Idols, 5 Clay Scarabs and 5 Gold Scarabs to Keyl Swiftclaw in Silithus. You must also obtain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
objectives: Bring 1 Qiraji Regal Drape, 2 Obsidian Idols, 5 Clay Scarabs and 5 Gold Scarabs to Keyl Swiftclaw in Silithus. You must also obtain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
details: I'm glad to hear you're aiding us in our attack on Ahn'Qiraj, $N. I can make you a protective item that'll be of assistance in the fight against our enemy, $c.
BI shall need a Qiraji drape, which I'll resize for you of course. I'll also need idols and scarabs which I'll use to create a suitable clasp.
BI promise you won't be disappointed.
completion: Ah yes... this drape is immaculate.
BTake this cloak, $N. May it protect you from the foul magic of the Qiraji.

8714.name: Moonstrike the Elder
completion: The heavens, in their countless stars, hold answers to earthly mysteries, $N. Might, then, the wise, and the lucky, gaze up and find truth?

8762.name: Metzen the Reindeer
desc: Find Metzen the Reindeer. Use the notes provided to you for clues as to where he is being held.
When you find Metzen, have the Pouch of Reindeer Dust in your possession so you can sprinkle some of the dust on him; this should free Metzen from his bonds of captivity.
Return the Pouch of Reindeer Dust to Wulmort Jinglepocket in Ironforge once Metzen is freed.
objectives: Find Metzen the Reindeer. Use the notes provided to you for clues as to where he is being held.
BWhen you find Metzen, have the Pouch of Reindeer Dust in your possession so you can sprinkle some of the dust on him; this should free Metzen from his bonds of captivity.
BReturn the Pouch of Reindeer Dust to Wulmort Jinglepocket in Ironforge once Metzen is freed.
details: DISASTER has struck! Metzen the Reindeer has been kidnapped!

BMetzen is one of Greatfather Winter's eight reindeer - and property of Smokywood Pastures. We've received not one but TWO ransom letters from groups claiming to have Metzen. With the holiday season well under way, we're strapped to the coin box here! Please - find Metzen and return him to us!
BCheck out the ransom letters for clues, and sprinkle this reindeer dust on him - it will free him from any of his bonds!
BPlease, hurry!
completion: You did it! Huzzah!

BMetzen flew back into Greatfather Winter's stables - yes Metzen can really fly - just a little while ago! The dust worked like a charm; I knew it would. You've saved the Feast of Winter Veil as well as Smokywood Pastures from disaster. Thank you, $N.
BListen... because of what you've done here, I want you to have this. It's something VERY special; if you have a mount, I think you'll get a kick out of it. Happy Winter Veil!

8858.name: Secrets of the Colossus - Regal
desc: Take the Colossus of Regal's Husk to Overseer Oilfist in Searing Gorge.
objectives: Take the Colossus of Regal's Husk to Overseer Oilfist in Searing Gorge.$B
details: There ain't nothin' I'd like more than to stuff this bug husk down Oilfist's fat face... Cept, I'm stuck here collectin' samples from that overgrown cockroach. I'll be here 'till the wee mornin' hours given the size o' that thing.
BTake this here sample to Oilfist fer me and do it fast, $c. He's payin' BIG!
BYar, Thorium Point - it be in the Searin' Gorge.
completion: Excellent. We could surely devise some incredibly powerful armor from this chitin. Here's the riches you were promised.

8906.name: An Earnest Proposition
desc: Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Beaststalker's Bindings to Deliana in Ironforge.
objectives: Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Beaststalker's Bindings to Deliana in Ironforge.
details: Well met, $c. I've something that might interest you.

BI have in my possession a set of armor much like the one worn by those of your profession, but of much higher quality. I'd be willing to trade the bracers for ordinary ones in exchange for a small favor.

BThe blood of the frostsabers and bears that inhabit Winterspring has properties I'm in need of at the moment. Bring me a sizeable sample of it along with the bracers and a small amount of gold. You shall find the effort worth your while.
completion: Excellent! Let's perform the trade then. It's hard to part with this excellent armor, but I'm afraid I won't be needing it any time soon.
BIf you're interested in performing more work for me, I might be willing to give up the rest of the pieces.

8930.name: In Search of Anthion
desc: Use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer at the entrance to Stratholme and speak with the ghost of Anthion Harmon.
objectives: Use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer at the entrance to Stratholme and speak with the ghost of Anthion Harmon.
details: Very well, $N. All that remains is to put the goblin's invention to the test. Word has it that Anthion was slain by the undead legions of Stratholme as he tried to enter its gates.
BTry using the device there and see if, indeed, you can speak with the dead!
completion: Mokvar had you contact me? I'll do my best to help you, but first I must ask a great favor of you.

8954.name: Anthion's Parting Words
desc: Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Lightforge Boots, Lightforge Legplates and Lightforge Spaulders.
objectives: Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Lightforge Boots, Lightforge Legplates and Lightforge Spaulders.
details: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.

BThe only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the medallion back together. Return to Deliana and tell her that Bodley is her only hope for finding the remaining pieces. Speak to her about any rewards you've arranged for.
BI, for once, shall rest in peace. I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
completion: I can't believe our lives are all but forfeit all because of a stupid medallion! And you're sure Anthion mentioned Bodley?
BWell, you've done your job so let's get your reward out of the way.

8978.name: Return to Mokvar
desc: Return to Mokvar in Orgrimmar with the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer.
objectives: Return to Mokvar in Orgrimmar with the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer.
details: It's been great working with you, $N. Here is the finished product.
BI hope it helps you in your current endeavors. And hey, if you don't mind, help spread the word. I wouldn't mind having more customers!
completion: You've returned with the device! I'm impressed by your dedication, $N. Excellent work.

9002.name: Saving the Best for Last
desc: Give Deliana your Lightforge Helm and Lightforge Breastplate.
objectives: Give Deliana your Lightforge Helm and Lightforge Breastplate.
details: That's an amazing story, $N! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved. Now maybe I'll be able to sleep at night with both eyes shut.
BAs to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you'll really enjoy.
completion: I'm going to miss you, $N. I owe you such a debt of gratitude; I think I'll never be able to repay it.
BI hope that you enjoy your new head and chest armor, and that it protects you for a long time to come.

9026.name: Tracing the Source
desc: Speak with Innkeeper Allison at The Gilded Rose in Stormwind's Trade District.
objectives: Speak with Innkeeper Allison at The Gilded Rose in Stormwind's Trade District.
details: We've got to find the source. I've seen a lot more people than usual - guards included - going in and out of The Gilded Rose. Talk to Allison. If she's selling them, she can tell you where they came from.
completion: Oh yes, I just got the perfume and cologne in stock recently. It's been selling so well, I don't know how long I can keep it on the shelves.
BIf you ask me, it's kind of boring. Everyone smelling the same? It smells great, but still.

9122.name: The Dread Citadel - Naxxramas
desc: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 2 Arcane Crystals, 1 Nexus Crystal and 30 gold pieces. You must also be Revered with the Argent Dawn.
objectives: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 2 Arcane Crystals, 1 Nexus Crystal and 30 gold pieces. You must also be Revered with the Argent Dawn.
details: In the thick of Plaguewood lies the entrance to the dread citadel of Naxxramas. Previously, all attempts to enter had been stymied by the magical wards placed upon the rune portal. That is, until now.

BWe have devised a way to gain entry via a permanent arcane cloaking of sorts - an old cantrip of the Kirin Tor with a few modifications of my own. With that said, the cloaking is costly. Since your dedication to the cause of the Dawn is admirable, we are willing to incur some of those costs.
completion: You will feel a slight tingle, $N. That sensation means it's working. Once complete, you will be able to enter Naxxramas by stepping upon the rune portal in Plaguewood.

9242.name: Polar Gloves
desc: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 5 Frozen Runes, 12 Enchanted Leather, 3 Essence of Water, 3 Cured Rugged Hides and 200 gold.
objectives: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 5 Frozen Runes, 12 Enchanted Leather, 3 Essence of Water, 3 Cured Rugged Hides and 200 gold.
details: Thanks to you and Omarion (May he rest in peace), I am now able to create Polar gloves. All you need to do is bring me the materials and pay a small crafting fee.
completion: Here is your order, $N. Delivered as promised!

9362.name: Warlord Krellian
desc: Retrieve the Prismatic Shell for Archmage Xylem. The Archmage resides in a tower atop the cliffs of Azshara.
objectives: Retrieve the Prismatic Shell for Archmage Xylem. The Archmage resides in a tower atop the cliffs of Azshara.
details: There isn't much time, $n! My scrying spells have revealed a powerful source of magic. I cannot leave the tower, and would ask you to kill the vile creature in possession of this artifact.
BThe pathetic little cretin is known as Warlord Krellian, hiding behind his guards in the Temple of Zin-Malor. Burn him to ashes and take the prismatic shell he covets so dearly.
completion: I must say, this shell has a strange aura. It seems only fitting that part of your reward for retrieving it would be to test its magical capabilities...

objectives: Jump from the top of the watchtower in Thendal Grove and use your Walk on Air ability to slow your fall.
* Use Walk on Air
details: Well hello there, ! Want to play a game?
All you've got to do is step up on that ledge... then jump! Use your innate ability to walk on the air to slow your fall and see how far forward you can float.

The rules are made up and the points don't matter, but you get bonus points if you can land right in front of Rorian the Dayseeker and startle him! He won't like it but I'll certainly get a good laugh if you can get him all worked up! Hah!

objectives: Confront Belthaan Brightwish along the road to the Shrine of Akir.
* Confront Belathaan Brightwish
* Defeat the Living Storms
details: The High Order has been warned of the consequences of meddling with the Windshaper's affairs. I think we need to make an example out of Belathaan and send him back to the High Order with a few bruises and a healthy respect for the boundaries we set.

Belathaan was seen leaving town, traveling north towards the Shrine of Akir. I don't know why he was going there, but confronting him alone on the road is the safest option. Find him, and put a bit of fear into his heart.

objectives: Bring the Titan Relic to Prospector Whelgar in the Wetlands excavation site.
* Titan Relic (Forever)
details: You pick up a fractured piece of the rock-mech automaton. It has a texture unlike anything you've touched before, a composite material of unknown makeup. This is certainly bound to be more 'device' than 'debris.'
Prospector Whelgar himself at his excavation site might have something useful to share about the relic.

objectives: Defeat Atrexis the Grave Knight in the City of Dalaran for Melisara in Tarren Mill.
* Atrexis the Grave Knight slain
details: Within the underbelly of the mage city to the north is a traitor to our kind. A necromancer of disturbing talent. He raises an army of undeath right under the Kirin Tor's nose.
I care not for the fate of the mage city, , but this grave knight spits in the face of everything we Forsaken stand for. Put an end to him. Show him no one is beyond the reach of the Dark Lady.
